verses.text: Yewe Teyofilo, mu gitabu ca mbere nanditse, navuze ivyo Yesu yakoze n’ivyo yigishije vyose kuva mu ntango y’igikorwa ciwe,
gushika ku musi yurizwa mw’ijuru, ahejeje kwongera kubwira intumwa yari yaratoranije ibizokurikira, ku bw’ubushobozi bwa Mpwemu Yera.
Inyuma y’urupfu rwiwe, yamaze imisi mirongo ine aja ariyereka izo ntumwa, azereka ibemenyetso bigaragaza ko ari muzima, yongera ababwira ivy’Ubwami bw’Imana.
Umusi umwe, ariko asangira na bo, yababwiye ashimitse ati: “Ntimuve i Yerusalemu, ariko murindire gushika Data abarungikiye ingabire yabasezeraniye, imwe nababwira.
Yohana yabatiza mu mazi, ariko mu gihe gito, mwebwe muzobatizwa muri Mpwemu Yera.”
Abari bakoraniye hamwe na we baramubaza bati: “Mwami, none ubu ni ho ugomba ugarukane ya ngoma ya Isirayeli?”
Arabishura ati: “Si ivyanyu kumenya ivy’ibihe canke imisi Data yashinze; ivyo biri mu bubasha bwiwe wenyene.
Ariko mwebwe muzohabwa ubushobozi Mpwemu Yera niyabazako; maze muzonshingira intahe i Yerusalemu, i Yudaya n’i Samariya hose, no gushika ku mpera z’isi.”
Ahejeje kubabwira ivyo, aca aduzwa mw’ijuru bamuraba, haza igicu kiramupfuka, ntibaba bakimubona.
Bakirangamije mu kirere baraba ingene aduga, haboneka abagabo babiri bambaye amakanzu zera, bahagarara i ruhande yabo.
Barababaza bati: “Yemwe bagabo b’i Galilaya, ni kuki muhagaze ngaha muraba mw’ijuru? Uwu Yesu akuwe muri mwebwe akajanwa mw’ijuru, azogaruka uko nyene mumubonye agenda.”
Nuko baca bava kuri uwo Musozi wa Elayono, basubira i Yerusalemu, ni nk’urugendo rwemewe ku musi w’Isabato.

Bashitse, baca baja mu cumba co hejuru, ico bari bamazemwo imisi, na bo ni aba: Petero, Yohana, Yakobo, Andereya, Filipo, Toma, Baruteremi, Matayo, Yakobo mwene Alufayo, Simoni Umuzelote, na Yuda mwene Yakobo.
Bose bakoranira hamwe bahuje umutima n’inama mu masengesho, bari kumwe na Mariya nyina wa Yesu n’abandi bagore, hamwe na bene nyina ba Yesu.
Muri iyo misi, Petero ahagarara hagati y’abo bene Data (bashika nk’ijana na mirongo ibiri),
arababwira ati: “Bene Data, Ivyanditswe vyategerezwa gushika kuri Yuda, umwe yaza arongoye abaje gufata Yesu. Ivyo Mpwemu Yera yari yarabivuze kera aciye kuri Dawidi.
Yuda yari umwe muri twebwe, kandi twari dusangiye igikorwa.”
(Ingero Yuda yahawe kubera ikibi yakoze yaguzwemwo itongo kandi ni ryo yaguyemwo, akoroka atanguje umutwe, inda yiwe irasaba, amara arasanzara.
Ababa i Yerusalemu bose baramenye iyo nkuru, baca bita iryo tongo Akelodama, bisobanurwa ngo: Itongo ry’amaraso.)
Petero avuga ati: “Mu gitabu ca Zaburi handitswe ngo: ‘I muhira iwe haze habe umusaka, ntihagire n’umwe azohaba.’ Kandi ngo: ‘Aze asubirizwe mu mabanga yiwe y’uburongozi.’
Ni co gituma dukwiye gutora umwe mu bo twabanye mu gihe cose Umwami Yesu yagendanye natwe,
uhereye igihe yabatizwa na Yohana, gushika igihe yaduzwa mw’ijuru. Uwo azoheza abe icabona kimwe muri twebwe co gushingira intahe ukuzuka kwiwe.”
Nuko baca batanga amazina y’abantu babiri ngo batoremwo umwe. Umwe yari Yosefu bita Barusaba (akongera akitwa Yusito), uwundi yari Matiyasi.
Nuko barasenga, bavuga bati: “Ewe Mwami Imana, ni wewe uzi imitima y’aba bantu bose. None rero niwerekane uwo utoranije muri aba babiri,
kugira ngo abandanye iki gikorwa c’intumwa, ico Yuda yataye akaja ukwiwe.”
Nuko bagira ubupfindo, Matiyasi aba ari we atorwa, aca yongerwa kuri bamwe cumi n’umwe.
Ku musi wa Pentekote, abizera bose bari bakoraniye hamwe.
Ubwo nyene haza igihinda kivuye mw’ijuru kimeze nk’umuyaga mwinshi w’igihuhusi, cuzura mu nzu barimwo.
Baca babona ibimeze nk’imbeya z’umuriro zitandukanije, zigenda zija kuri umwumwe wese mu bari ngaho bose.
Bose baca buzura Mpwemu Yera, batangura kuvuga mu zindi ndimi nk’uko Mpwemu Yera abashoboje kuzivuga.
Kandi hariho Abayuda benshi bubaha Imana bari i Yerusalemu, bari ngaho bavuye mu mahanga atandukanye ari kw’isi.
Bumvise ukwo guhinda, bose baca birukira aho hantu, baratangara cane kuko umwe wese yumva abizera bavuga ururimi rwiwe.
Mu gutangara bakabazanya bati: “Aba bantu bose bariko baravuga si Abanyagalilaya?
None bigenda gute ngo umwumwe wese muri twebwe abumve bavuga ururimi kavukire rw’iwe?
Muri twebwe harimwo Abapariti, Abamedi, Abelamiti, n’abava i Mezopotamiya, i Yudaya i Kapadokiya, i Ponto, muri Aziya,
i Furugiya, i Pamfiliya, muri Egiputa no mu gice ca Libiya cegereye i Kurene, n’abavuye i Roma
(bagizwe n’Abayuda n’abinjiye mw’idini ry’Abayuda), Abanyakireti, n’Abarabu. Kandi twese tubumva bavuga ibitangaza vy’Imana mu ndimi z’iwacu.”
Nuko bose barumirwa bongera barazazanirwa, babazanya bati: “Mbega ibi ni iki?”
Ariko bamwe barabacokora bavuga bati: “Aba bantu baborewe, banyoye igisama.”
Petero aca arahaguruka ari kumwe na bamwe cumi n’umwe, avuga n’ijwi rirenga abwira abari ngaho ati: “Bayuda benewacu, namwe mwese muri i Yerusalemu, nimuntege amatwi, mutahure neza ibibaye.
Aba bantu ntibaborewe nk’uko bamwe muvyiyumvira. Raba haracari isaha zitatu z’igitondo.
Ibi ni ivyari vyaravuzwe n’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yoweli, aho yavuga ati:

‘Uku ni ko Imana ivuze, iti: Mu bihe vya nyuma nzosuka Mpwemu wanje ku bantu bose; abahungu banyu n’abakobwa banyu bazovugishwa nanje, n’abasore banyu bazobona ivyo beretswe, abatama banyu bazorota inzozi.
N’abasavyi banje, abagabo n’abagore, muri iyo misi nzobasukako Mpwemu wanje kandi bazovugishwa nanje.
Nzokwerekana ibitangaza hejuru kw’ijuru n’ibimenyetso hasi kw’isi: amaraso, umuriro, n’ugupfunduka kw’umwotsi.
Izuba rizohinduka umwijima, ukwezi guhinduke amaraso, imbere y’ukuza kwa wa musi w’Uhoraho uhambaye kandi w’ubwiza.
Kandi umuntu wese azokwambaza izina ry’Uhoraho azokizwa.’
Yemwe Bisirayeli, Yesu w’i Nazareti yari umuntu yashingiwe intahe n’Imana mu bitangaza, utwumiza n’ibimenyetso Imana yamukoresheje muri mwebwe, nk’uko ubwanyu mubizi.
Uwo Yesu yatanzwe mu maboko yanyu ku bw’umugambi Imana yari yatareguye kuva kera, maze namwe mufashijwe n’abanyakibi n’abanyamahanga, mumwica mumubamvye ku musaraba.
Ariko Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye, imukura mu vyara vy’urupfu, kuko bitashoboka ko urupfu rumugumya.
Dawidi yaramuvuzeko ati: ‘Namye nshize amaso yanje k’Uhoraho. Aho ari i buryo bwanje, sinzonyiganyizwa.
Ni co gituma umutima wanje unezerewe, ururimi rwanje rugahimbarwa, n’umubiri wanje ukaruhukana ivyizigiro,
kuko utazorekera umushaha wanje mu kibanza c’abapfuye, canke ngo uze ureke uwera wawe ngo abore.
Wamenyesheje inzira y’ubugingo, uzonyuzuza umunezero ndi imbere yawe.’
Bene Data, ndashobora kubabwira ntakekeranya ko sogokuruza wacu Dawidi yapfuye agahambwa, kandi n’imva yiwe iracari hano gushika n’uwu musi.
Yari umuvugishwa n’Imana kandi yari azi ko Imana yari yaramusezeraniye ishizeko n’indahiro ko izokwimika ku ngoma yiwe umwe mu ruvyaro rwiwe.
Yeretswe ibizoba muri kazoza, avuga ivy’ukuzuka kwa Kristo, ko atazorekerwa i kuzimu mu kibanza c’abapfuye, kandi ko n’umubiri wiwe utazobora.
Uwo Yesu Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye, twese turi ivyabona vyo kubishingira intahe.
None rero, amaze gushika i buryo bw’Imana, yakiriye Mpwemu Yera, uwo Data yari yarasezeranye, amusuka kuri twebwe. Nk’uko muriko murabibona kandi muvyumva.
Dawidi ntiyaduze mw’ijuru, ariko ni we yavuze ati: ‘Uhoraho yabariye Umwami wanje ati: Icara i buryo bwanje
kugeza abansi bawe bose ndabashize musi y’ibirenge vyawe.’
Nuko rero Abisirayeli nibamenye ukuri badakekeranya ko uwo Yesu, uwo mwebwe mwabamvye, Imana yamugize Umwami na Kristo.”
Abari ngaho bose bavyumvise bibacumita mu mitima, babaza Petero n’izindi ntumwa bati: “Bagabo benewacu, dukore iki?”
Petero arabishura ati: “Umuntu wese muri mwebwe niyihane, abatizwe mw’izina rya Yesu Kristo, kugira ngo ivyaha vyanyu bibone guharirwa, ni ho muzoronka ingabire ya Mpwemu Yera.
Kuko iryo sezerano ari iryanyu, n’abana banyu, n’abari kure bose, abazohamagarwa n’Umwami Imana yacu bose.”
Petero aca abandanya ababwira ayandi majambo menshi yo kubinginga no kubahanura, avuga ati: “Nimuhunge uru runganwe rw’inkozi z’ibibi.”
Nuko abizeye ayo majambo ya Petero barabatizwa, abashika ibihumbi bitatu biyongera ku gitigiri c’abizera.
Maze abizera bose bashishikara gushira imitima ku vyo intumwa zigisha, gusangira ivyabo, kumanyagura imikate, no gusenga.
Umuntu wese aterwa n’ubwoba ku bw’ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso vyinshi vyakorwa n’intumwa.
Abizera bose baba hamwe kandi bagasangira ivyabo vyose.
Bagurisha amatongo n’ivyo batunze vyose, bakagabura amahera, bakurikije ubukene bw’umwumwe wese.
Imisi yose bama bakoranira mu rusengero, bakamanyagurira imikate mu mihana yabo, bakongera bagasangirira hamwe bafise imitima ihuye kandi banezerewe.
Bama bashima Imana ibihe vyose kandi na bo bagashimwa n’abantu bose, maze Umwami Imana na we akama abongerereza igitigiri c’abakizwa.
Umusi umwe Petero na Yohana bari baduze mu rusengero gusenga, hari kw’isaha y’icenda.
Hariho umuntu yavutse amugaye, bakama imisi yose bamujana bakamushira kw’irembo ry’urusengero ryitwa Irembo Ryiza kugira ngo asege abaje mu rusengero.
Abonye Petero na Yohana bagira binjire mu rusengero, arabasega.
Maze Petero na Yohana barahindukira baramuraba, hanyuma Petero amubwira ati: “Nuturabe!”
Uwo muntu aca abahanga amaso cane yiteze ko hari ico bagira bamuhe.
Ariko Petero aca amubwira ati: “Ifeza n’inzahabu nta vyo mfise, ariko ico mfise ndakiguhaye. Mw’izina rya Yesu Kristo w’i Nazareti, va hasi utambuke!”
Aca amufata ukuboko kw’i buryo, aramuhagurutsa, ubwo nyene ibirenge vyiwe n’ingingo zavyo bica birakomera.
Nuko aca atangura gutambuka, yinjirana na bo mu rusengero, atambuka neza, yiterera hejuru, ahimbaza Imana.
Abantu bose bamubonye agendagenda ashima Imana,
bamenya ko ari umwe yahora yama yicara kw’irembo ry’urusengero ryitwa Irembo Ryiza asegerereza. Barumirwa cane, batangajwe n’ibihejeje kumubako.
Kubera ko wa muntu yaguma afashe Petero na Yohana, abantu bose biruka iyo bari, barundana mw’ibaraza ryitwa Ibaraza rya Salomo, batangaye cane.
Petero abibonye, arababwira ati: “Yemwe Bisirayeli, ni kubera iki ibi bibatangaje? Ni kubera iki muturaba nk’aho umenga ni ubushobozi bwacu canke ukwubaha Imana kwacu kwatumye uwu muntu atambuka?
Imana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaka na Yakobo, Imana ya ba sogokuruza, ni yo ihesheje icubahiro umusavyi wayo Yesu, uwo mwanse, mukamushikiriza Pilato ngo yicwe, naho we yari yahisemwo kumurekura.
Mwihakanye Uwera, Umugororotsi, musaba ko barekura umwicanyi.
Mwishe uwutanga ubugingo, ariko Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye, twebwe turi ivyabona vyo kubishingira intahe.
Ni kubwo kwizera izina rya Yesu, uwu muntu mubona kandi muzi yakize. Ni kubwo kwizera Yesu n’izina ryiwe vyamukijije neza nk’uko namwe mwese muvyibonera.
None rero bavukanyi, ndazi ko mwabikoze mu kutamenya, co kimwe n’abatware banyu.
Ariko uko ni ko Imana yashikije ivyo yari yaravugiye mu kanwa k’abavugishwa na yo bose, ivuga ko Kristo akwiye kubabazwa.
Nuko rero nimwihane, muhindukire, kugira ngo ivyaha vyanyu bihanagurwe, ngo ibihe vy’impemburo bibone ingene biza, bivuye imbere y’Umwami Imana,
maze yongere ibarungikire uwo yabasezeraniye ngo ababere Kristo, ari we Yesu.
Uwo akwiye kuguma mw’ijuru kugeza igihe Imana izohindurira ibintu vyose bikaba bisha, nk’uko yabivuze kera ikoresheje abavugishwa bayo bera.
Kuko Mose yavuze ati: ‘Uhoraho Imana yanyu azobahagurukiriza uwuvugishwa n’Imana ameze nkanje, imukuye muri mwebwe nyene. Muze mumwumvire mu vyo azobabwira vyose.
Uwutazomwumvira aze arandurwe mu bwoko bwiwe.’
Kandi, n’abandi bavugishwa n’Imana bose uhereye kuri Samweli, baravugishijwe ku biriko biraba uno musi.
Muri abuzukuruza b’abo bavugishwa b’Imana, n’abana b’isezerano iyo Mana yagiranye na ba sogokuruza banyu. Yabwiye Aburahamu iti: ‘Mu ruvyaro rwawe ni ho imiryango yose yo mw’isi izohererwa umugisha.’
Imana yazura umusavyi wayo, maze ica ibanza kumutuma kuri mwebwe, kugira ngo umwe wese muri mwebwe ahabwe umugisha mu kuva mu nzira ziwe mbi.”
Abaherezi bari kumwe n’umukuru w’abarinzi b’urusengero hamwe n’Abasadukayo baca baja aho Petero na Yohana bariko barigishiziza.
Bari bashavujwe cane n’uko izo ntumwa zariko zigisha abantu, zibabwira ivyo kuzuka kw’abapfuye kubonerwa muri Yesu Kristo.
Baca bafata Petero na Yohana, kandi kubera bwari bwije, babashira mw’ibohero gushika bukeye.
Ariko benshi mu bumvise ubutumwa bavuze bari bizeye, igitigiri c’abizera kirongerekana gushika hafi ibihumbi bitanu.
Bukeye, abatware, abakuru n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe bakoranira i Yerusalemu.
Anasi umuherezi mukuru ni ho yari ari, ari kumwe na Kayafa, na Yohana, na Alegizandere hamwe n’abandi benshi bo mu muryango w’abaherezi bakuru.
Nuko barengutsa Petero na Yohana, babashira hagati, baca batangura kubabazagiza bati: “Ni ubushobozi nyabaki mwakoresheje, canke ni mw’izina rya nde mwakoze ivyo?”
Maze Petero, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, aca ababwira ati: “Batware nanwe bashingatahe b’ubu bwoko,
uwu musi turiko turasambishwa kubera igikorwa ciza cakorewe ikimuga, tubazwa n’ingene cakize.

Nuko rero mwese nimumenye neza ibi, mwebwe ubwanyu hamwe n’ubwoko bwose bw’Abisirayeli: uwu muntu ahagaze imbere yanyu yakize mw’izina rya Yesu Kristo w’i Nazareti, uwo mwabamvye, ariko Imana ikamuzura mu bapfuye.
Ni we ‘buye ryatawe n’abubatsi, ariko ryahindutse irigumya imfuruka.’
Nta wundi agakiza karonkerwamwo, atari we, kuko ata rindi zina twahawe musi y’ijuru ryo gukirizwamwo.”
Babonye ubushizi bw’amanga bwari muri Petero na Yohana, bakamenya ko batize, ahubwo ko ari abantu batobato, baratangara cane, ariko bamenya ko bagendanye na Yesu.
Kandi kubera babona uwo muntu yakize ahagararanye na bo, nta co bari bafise bashobora gusubizayo.
Nuko barabataramura, batangura kuvugana hagati yabo.
Barabazanya bati: “Mbega aba bantu tubagire dute? Abantu bose baba i Yerusalemu barazi ko bakoze igitangaza kigaragara neza, kandi natwe ntidushobora kubihakana.
Ariko kugira tubuze ibi bintu kubandanya vyamamara mu bantu, reka tubabuze kubandanya bigisha muri iryo zina rya Yesu.”
Nuko barabahamagara, babihanikiriza ngo ntibaze bahirahire ngo bongere kuvuga canke kwigisha mw’izina rya Yesu.
Maze Petero na Yohana barabishura bati: “Mbega mubona ko ikibereye mu nyonga z’Imana, ari kwubaha mwebwe canke ari kwubaha iyo Mana? Gira ico mubitubwiyeko!
Kuko twebwe ntidushobora kureka kuvuga ivyo twiboneye kandi twiyumviye.”
Nuko babanza kubatera ubwoba cane, hanyuma barabarekura barataha, bamaze kubura ingene bobahana; kubera abari ngaho bose bariko bashima Imana ku vyabaye.
Uwo muntu yari yakize mu buryo bw’igitangaza yari afise imyaka irenga mirongo ine.
Petero na Yohana bamaze kurekurwa baca basubira aho bagenzi babo bari, babiganira ivyo abaherezi bakurubakuru n’abakuru bababwiye.
Bavyumvise, bose baca bashira amajwi yabo hejuru, basenga Imana, bavuga bati: “Mwami Imana uganje vyose, ni wewe waremye ijuru, isi n’ikiyaga, n’ibibibamwo vyose.
Ni wewe wavuze biciye kuri Mpwemu Yera, no mu kanwa k’umusavyi wawe, sogokuruza Dawidi, uti: ‘Ni kuki amahanga yuzuye uburake, kandi ni kuki bategura imigambi ata co ishobora gushikako?
Abami bo mw’isi bakuye hasi, n’abatware bagiye hamwe ngo bagwanye Uhoraho n’uwo yarobanuje amavuta.’

Ni mu vy’ukuri ivyo vyarabaye, Herode Antipa, Pontiyo Pilato, Abanyamahanga hamwe n’ubwoko bw’Abisirayeli bo muri iki gisagara, barifatanije kugira ngo bagwanye umusavyi wawe yera Yesu, uwo warobanuje amavuta.
Ariko bashikije ico wari waramaze kugena ko kizoshika, mu bushobozi bwawe no mu gushaka kwawe.
None rero Mwami Imana, nurabe ingene badutera ubwoba, maze ushoboze abasavyi bawe kwigisha ijambo ryawe bashize amanga rwose.
Gorora ukuboko kwawe maze ukize ingwara, ukore ibitangaza n’utwumiza mw’izina ry’umusavyi wawe yera Yesu.”
Bahejeje gusenga, aho bari bakoraniye haratigita, bose buzuzwa Mpwemu Yera, baca bigisha ijambo ry’Imana bashize amanga rwose.
Abizera bose bari bahuje umutima n’inama muri vyose. Nta n’umwe yavuga ko ivyo atunze ari ivyiwe wenyene, ariko basangira ivyo bafise vyose.
Intumwa zabandanya gushingira intahe ukuzuka kw’Umwami Yesu zuzuye ubushobozi bwinshi, kandi ubuntu bw’Imana bwinshi bwaguma bugwira kuri bo bose.
Nta n’umwe yagira ico akeheje muri bo, kuko abari bafise amatongo canke amazu, babigurisha bakazana amahera vyaguzwe,
bakayashikiriza intumwa, maze na zo zikayabagabanganya, umwumwe wese akaronka ayakwiranye n’ivyo akenye.
Nk’akarorero, Yosefu, Umulewi yava i Kupuro, uwo intumwa zise Baranaba (risobanura ngo Umuntu atera intege),
yagurishije itongo ryiwe aca azana amahera yose yarigurishije, ayashikiriza intumwa.

headings.text: Petero na Yohana barengutswa imbere y’Inama Nkuru

verses.text: Ariko hariho umugabo yitwa Ananiya, yari afise umugore yitwa Safira. Bagurisha itongo ryabo babigiye inama.
Aca yumvikana n’uwo mugore wiwe, bafata igice c’amahera bakuyemwo barakinyegeza, igice kindi aba ari co bajana bagishira imbere y’ibirenge vy’intumwa.
Maze Petero abaza Ananiya ati: “Ananiya, ni gute wemeye ko Satani yuzuza umutima wawe guhenda Mpwemu Yera mu kunyegeza igice c’amahera wagurishije itongo ryawe?
Mbega utararigurisha ntiryari iryawe? Kandi umaze kurigurisha, amahera ntiyari ayawe? Vyakugendeye gute ngo wiyumvire gukora ikintu nk’ico? Erega si twebwe wabeshe, ahubwo wabeshe Imana!”
Ananiya acumva ivyo, agwa hasi arahwera. Abumvise ibibaye bose batekerwa n’ubwoba.
Maze abasore bari ngaho baca bava hasi, batekera ikiziga ciwe bakijana kugihamba.
Haciye nk’amasaha atatu umugore wiwe aca arashika, atazi ivyabaye.
Petero aramubaza ati: “Mbwira! Aya ni amahera yose mwe na Ananiya mwakuye mw’itongo mwagurishije?” Safira amwishura ati: “Egome, ni ayo.”
Petero aca amubwira ati: “Vyabagendeye gute ngo mwumvikane guhenda Mpwemu w’Umwami Imana? Raba ibirenge vy’abavuye guhamba umugabo wawe bigeze aho imbere y’umuryango, kandi nawe barakujana.”
Ubwo nyene aca agwa hasi imbere y’ibirenge vya Petero, aracikana. Ba bantu baca barinjira, basanga na we arapfuye, baramufata baja kumuhamba, bamuryamika i ruhande y’umugabo wiwe.
Ishengero ryose n’abumvise ivyabaye bose baca bafatwa n’ubwoba bwinshi.
Inyuma y’ivyo, intumwa zibandanya zikora ibitangaza n’utwumiza mu bantu, kandi abizera bose bama bahurira hamwe mw’ibaraza rya Salomo, bahuje umutima n’inama.
Nta n’umwe yubahuka kwifatanya na bo, n’aho abantu babemera cane.
Ariko abantu benshi, abagabo n’abagore barizera Umwami, igitigiri cabo cama congerekana.
Vyatuma kandi abantu benshi bama bazana abagwaye bakabaryamika mu nderuzo no ku birago i ruhande y’inzira, kugira ngo Petero arenganye igitutu ciwe gipfume kibashikira.
Abantu isinzi bama bakorana bavuye mu mihana ikikuje Yerusalemu, bazanye abagwaye n’abafashwe n’impwemu mbi, kandi bose barakira.
Maze umuherezi mukuru n’abo bari bafadikanije, bari mu muce b’Abasadukayo, babagirira ishari ryinshi intumwa.
Nuko barabafata babashira mw’ibohero.
Ariko mw’ijoro, umumarayika w’Umwami Imana yugurura imiryango y’iryo bohero, arabasohora.
Maze arababwira ati: “Nimugende muhagarare mu rusengero, mubwire abantu ubutumwa bwuzuye bw’ivy’ubu bugingo bushasha.”

Bukeye binjira mu rusengero nk’uko babariwe, batangura kwigisha. Umuherezi mukuru n’abo bari bafatanije bashitse, baca bakoranya inama nkuru y’abarongoye ubwoko bw’Abisirayeli, bahejeje barungika abarinzi b’urusengero kw’ibohero kuzana za ntumwa.
Ariko abo barinzi b’urusengero bashitse kw’ibohero, ntibabasangayo, baca basubira inyuma gutanga inkuru,
bavuga bati: “Twasanze ibohero ryugaye neza, n’abarinzi bahagaze ku miryango, ariko twuguruye twasanze ata muntu n’umwe yariyo.”
Umukuru w’abarinzi b’urusengero n’abaherezi bakurubakuru bavyumvise barazazanirwa cane bibaza ibishobora gukurikira.
Ubwo nyene haca haza umuntu, ababwira ati: “Ba bagabo mwashira mw’ibohero, bahagaze mu rusengero bariko barigisha abantu.”
Wa mukuru w’abarinzi b’urusengero aca ajana n’abarinzi bari kumwe, baja kuzana izo ntumwa. Ariko babazana ku neza badakoresheje inguvu, kuko batinya ko abantu bobatera amabuye.
Babashikanye, babashira imbere y’inama nkuru y’abarongoye ubwo bwoko, maze umuherezi mukuru atangura kubasambisha.
Arababwira ati: “Twari twabihanikirije kutongera kwigisha muri iryo zina. Ariko mwakwiragije inyigisho zanyu i Yerusalemu hose, kandi mwamaramaje kutwegekako amaraso y’uwo muntu.”
Petero n’izindi ntumwa barishura bati: “Dutegerezwa kwubaha Imana kuruta abantu!
Imana ya ba sogokuruza yazuye Yesu mu bapfuye, uwo mwari mwishe mumubamvye ku musaraba.
Imana yaramushize hejuru imwicarika i buryo bwayo nk’Umutware n’Umukiza, kugira ngo ahe Abisirayeli ukwihana n’uguharirwa ivyaha vyabo.
Ivyo twebwe turabishingira intahe, kandi na Mpwemu Yera arabishingira intahe, uwo Imana yahaye abamwumvira.”
Bavyumvise barashangashirwa, bagomba kubicisha.
Ariko hari Umufarisayo yitwa Gamaliyeli, yari umwigisha w’ivyagezwe, yubahwa cane n’abantu bose. Arahaguruka, asaba ko bataramura gatoya izo ntumwa.
Aca abwira abagize inama nkuru y’Abayuda ati: “Bagabo bo muri Isirayeli, mwiyumvire neza ku vyo mugomba kugirira aba bantu.
Mu misi iheze, uwitwa Teyuda yaje yigira uwuhambaye, abantu bashika amajana ane baramukurikira. Amaze kwicwa, abamukurikira bose baciye basanzara, ntibagira ico bashikako.
Inyuma yaho, Yuda Umunyagalilaya yaje mu misi yo gusansuma abantu, arongoye umugwi w’abantu bagumutse. Na we nyene yarishwe, abamukurikira barasanzara.
None rero ku bw’aba bantu na bo, ndabahanure: Nimurekure aba bantu bigire! Kuko nimba ivyo bariko barakora vyavuye ku bantu, nta ho bizoshika.
Ariko nimba biva ku Mana, ntimuzoshobora kubagwanya; ahubwo muzosanga muriko mugwanya Imana.”
Nuko bemera impanuro ziwe, bahamagaza za ntumwa, barazikubitisha, bazitegeka kudasubira kwigisha muri iryo zina rya Yesu, baca barabarekura barataha.
Izo ntumwa zica ziva imbere y’Inama Nkuru y’abarongoye ubwo bwoko zinezerewe, kuko Imana yari yabonye ko bibabereye kubabazwa bahorwa izina rya Kristo.
Imisi yose bama mu rusengero canke mu mihana, ntibigeze bahagarika kwigisha no kwamamaza inkuru nziza, bavuga ko Yesu ari we Kristo.
Muri iyo misi, igitigiri c’abigishwa caguma ciyongera. Abayuda bavuga Ikigiriki bari muri bo bidogera Abayuda b’imvukira ko birengagiza abapfakazi babo iyo batanga imfungurwa zo ku musi ku musi.
Bamwe cumi na babiri baca bakoranira hamwe n’abandi bigishwa, bavuga bati: “Si vyiza ko dufata minenegwe igikorwa co kugabura ijambo ry’Imana bitumwe no kugabura ivyokurya.
Bene Data, nimutoranye abantu indwi muri mwebwe, mushingira intahe ko buzuye Mpwemu Yera n’ubwenge, tubazeze ico gikorwa,
hanyuma natwe duheze twiyegurire igikorwa co gusenga no kwigisha Ijambo ry’Imana.”

Abari ngaho bose bashima ico ciyumviro, maze batoranya Setefano, umuntu yari yuzuye ukwizera kandi yari yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, na Filipo, na Purokoro, Nikanori, Timoni, Parumena, na Nikola Umunyantiyokiya yinjiye mw’idini ry’Abayuda.
Nuko abo bantu bazanwa imbere y’intumwa, zirabasengera, zibarambitseko ibiganza.
Nuko ijambo ry’Imana ribandanya kwamamara, igitigiri c’abigishwa kiragwira cane i Yerusalemu, kandi n’abaherezi benshi bo mw’idini ry’Abayuda barizera.
Setefano yari umuntu yuzuye ubuntu n’ubushobozi vy’Imana, vyatuma akora ibitangaza n’ibimenyetso vyinshi imbere y’abantu.

Maze abantu bamwebamwe bo mw’Isinagogi y’abiyita Abahoze ari abagurano bidegemvya, ari bo Bayuda b’i Kurene n’abo muri Alegizanderiya, bafatanije n’abava mu ntara za Kilikiya na Aziya, bahagurukira rimwe guhaririza Setefano.
Ariko ntibashobora guhagarara imbere y’ubwenge yahabwa na Mpwemu Yera iyo ariko aravuga.
Ni ko guca baha ingero abantu mu mpisho ngo baje kumudodobereza bamurega bati: “Twumvise Setefano atuka Mose, yongera atuka n’Imana.”
Maze baca bagumura abantu bose, harimwo n’abakuru b’ubwo bwoko n’abigisha b’ivyagezwe, bafata Setefano, bamutwara imbere y’inama nkuru y’abarongoye ubwo bwoko.
Baca bazana ibindi vyabona vy’ibinyoma, bavuga bati: “Uwu mugabo yama atuka urusengero rwera n’ivyagezwe.
Twaramwumvise avuga ko uwo Yesu w’i Nazareti azosambura urusengero yongere ahindure imigenzo Mose yadusigiye.”
Abari bicaye mu nama nkuru y’abarongoye ubwo bwoko bose bamwihweje, babona mu maso hiwe hasa n’ah’umumarayika.
Nuko umuherezi mukuru aramubaza ati: “Ivyo bakwagiriza ni vyo?”
Na we amwishura ati: “Bavukanyi namwe bavyeyi, nimuntege amatwi ndababwire. Imana y’ubwiza yiyeretse sogokuruza Aburahamu akiri i Mesopotamiya, imbere y’uko aja kuba i Harani.
Yamubwiye iti: ‘Va mu gihugu cawe no mu bwoko bwawe, uje mu gihugu nzokwereka.’
Nuko Aburahamu ava mu gihugu c’Abakarudaya, aja kuba i Harani. Se wiwe amaze gupfa, Imana imurungika muri iki gihugu mubamwo.
Nta mugabane yamuhaye muri ico gihugu, nta n’aho guhonyoza ikirenge, ariko Imana yamusezeraniye ko we n’uruvyaro rwiwe bazokwegukira iki gihugu, n’aho ico gihe Aburahamu atari bwaronke umwana.
Imana yamubwiye iti: ‘Uruvyaro rwawe ruzoba mu gihugu kitari icabo, bitwe abanyamahanga kandi bazogirwa abaja, bacinyizwe imyaka amajana ane.’
Imana irongera kandi ivuga iti: ‘Ariko nzohana ihanga rizobagira abagurano, kandi mu nyuma bazorivamwo, baze kunsengera muri iki gihugu.’

Nuko ica iha Aburahamu isezerano ryo gukebwa. Aburahamu na we avyara Isaka, amukeba ku musi ugira umunani. Isaka avyara Yakobo aramukeba, Yakobo na we avyara ba sogokuruza cumi na babiri, na we arabakeba.
Kubera ishari ba sogokuruza bagiriye Yosefu, baramugurishije muri Egiputa; ariko Imana yari kumwe na we,
maze imukiza amarushwa yiwe yose. Imuha ubwenge budasanzwe n’ikiganza ciza kuri Farawo, umwami wa Egiputa, na we amuha ubutware kuri Egiputa yose no mu bakozi biwe.
Igihe kimwe inzara itera mu gihugu cose ca Egiputa n’i Kanani, abantu babona amakuba, ba sogokuruza babura ivyokurya.
Yakobo yumvise ko muri Egiputa hariyo ingano, arungikayo ba sogokuruza incuro ya mbere.
Basubiyeyo ubwa kabiri, Yosefu yihishurira benewabo, Farawo na we abona kumenya umuryango wa Yosefu.
Maze Yosefu aca atumako se Yakobo n’umuryango wiwe wose. Bose hamwe bari mirongo indwi na batanu.
Nuko Yakobo amanuka muri Egiputa. Mu nyuma arapfa, co kimwe na ba sogokuruza.
Ibisigarira vyabo vyatahukanywe i Shekemu, bishingurwa mu mva ziri ahantu Aburahamu yari yaguriye abahungu ba Hamori i Shekemu.
Igihe c’uko Imana ishitsa amasezerano yahaye Aburahamu cegereje, igitigiri c’ubwoko bwacu cari kimaze kugwira, kirongerekana cane muri Egiputa.
Mu nyuma muri Egiputa himikwa uwundi mwami atigeze amenya ivya Yosefu.
Akorera ikibi ubwoko bwacu, ategeka ba sogokuruza guta abana babo b’inzoya kugira ngo ntibabeho.
Ico gihe ni ho Mose yavuka, avuka ari umwana adasanzwe imbere y’Imana. Nuko arererwa mu muryango wiwe gushika ashikanye amezi atatu.
Amaze gutabwa, umukobwa wa Farawo aramutora, amurera nk’umwana wiwe bwite.
Nuko Mose yigishwa ubwenge bwose bw’Abanyegiputa, kandi aba uwuhambaye mu mvugo no mu ngiro.
Mose amaze imyaka mirongo ine, yumva mu mutima yotemberera benewabo b’Abisirayeli.
Maze asanga Umunyegiputa ariko akubita Umwisirayeli, aca aramutabara, ndetse yica uwo Munyegiputa.
Mose we yibaza ko benewabo baza gutahura ko Imana iriko iramukoresha mu kubakiza. Ariko Abisirayeli bo ntibabitahuye gutyo.
Bukeye Mose aragenda asanga Abisirayeli babiri bariko baragwana, aca agerageza kubumvikanisha, ababwira ati: ‘Mwa bagabo mwe, ko muri abavukanyi, ni iki gituma mugiriranira nabi?’
Uwariko ararenganya mugenziwe aca asunura Mose, amubaza ati: ‘Ni nde yakugize umutware n’umucamanza wacu?
Ugomba kunyica nk’uko ejo wishe wa Munyegiputa?’
Mose avyumvise, aca ahungira mu ntara ya Midiyani, abayo nk’umunyamahanga, avyarirayo abahungu babiri.
Haheze imyaka mirongo ine, umumarayika yiyereka Mose mu bugaragwa bw’Umusozi Sinayi, mu rubeya rw’umuriro wakira mu gisaka.
Maze Mose atangajwe n’ivyo abonye, yegera igisaka ngo arabe neza ivyo ari vyo, ni ho yumva ijwi ry’Umwami Imana rimubwira riti:
‘Ndi Imana ya ba sogokuruza, Imana ya Aburahamu, ya Isaka, na Yakobo.’ Mose ahinda agashitsi kubera ubwoba bwinshi, ntiyubahuka gusubira kwunamuka ngo arabe.
Umwami Imana aramubwira ati: ‘Ambura ibirato vyawe, kuko aha hantu uhagaze ari ahera.
Nabonye agacinyizo abantu banje barimwo muri Egiputa, numva n’amaborogo yabo, none manukanywe no kubakiza. Rero nuze, ngomba kugutuma muri Egiputa.’

Uwu ni Mose nyene bari baranse igihe bavuga bati: ‘Ni nde yakugize umutware n’umucamanza wacu?’ Imana ubwayo ni yo yamwirungikiye ngo abe umutware n’umucunguzi wabo, biciye ku mumarayika yamwiyeretse ari mu gisaka caka umuriro.
Yabakuje muri Egiputa utwumiza n’ibitangaza yakoreye muri ico gihugu, ku kiyaga gitukura, no mu myaka mirongo ine bamaze mu bugaragwa.
Uwo Mose nyene ni we mu nyuma yabwiye Abisirayeli ati: ‘Imana izobahagurukiriza uwuvugishwa n’Imana ameze nkanje muri mwebwe.’
Yari kumwe n’ikoraniro rya ba sogokuruza mu bugaragwa, igihe umumarayika yavuganira na we ku musozi Sinayi, agaca amuha amajambo y’ubugingo kugira ngo na we ayaduhe.
Ariko ba sokuruza bacu baranse kumwumvira, bitandukanya na we, mu mitima yabo bipfuza kwisubirira muri Egiputa.
Maze babwira Aroni bati: ‘Ducurire imana zo kutuja imbere, kuko tutazi ivyashikiye Mose, uwadukuye mu gihugu ca Egiputa.’
Ico gihe ni ho bakora ikigirwamana mw’ishusho y’ishuri y’inka. Bagishikanira ibimazi bongera bagira umusi mukuru wo kwigina ico kintu bari bakoresheje amaboko yabo.

Maze Imana ica irabareka ngo basenge izuba, ukwezi n’inyenyeri. Kandi ivyo bihuye n’ivyanditswe mu bitabu vy’abavugishwa n’Imana, bivuga ngo: ‘Mbega ibimazi n’amashikanwa mwatanze mu bugaragwa, muri irya myaka mirongo ine, ni jewe mwabishikaniye ga yemwe Bisirayeli?
Oya, mwari mwitwaje ihema rya Moleki, n’ikimenyetso c’inyenyeri c’ikigirwamana canyu Refani, ibishushanyo mwicuriye ngo mubisenge. Ni co gituma nzobirukana mukaja kure hirya y’i Babiloni.’
Ba sogokuruza bacu bari bafise ihema ry’isezerano bagendana mu bugaragwa. Ryari ryubatswe nk’uko Imana yari yategetse Mose, hakurikijwe ishusho yari yeretswe.

Bamaze guhabwa iryo hema, ba sogokuruza, barongowe na Yosuwa, baje barizanye igihe bafata iki gihugu, Imana imaze kucirukanamwo amahanga yakibamwo imbere yabo. Iryo hema ryagumye mu gihugu gushika mu gihe c’umwami Dawidi.
Dawidi na we agirirwa ubuntu bwinshi n’Imana, bituma asaba kwubakira ihema Imana ya Yakobo.
Ariko Salomo ni we yahavuye ayubakira inzu.
Yamara, Iyisumbavyose ntiba mu nzu zubatswe n’amaboko y’abantu, nk’uko uwavugishwa n’Imana yavuze ati:
‘Ijuru ni intebe yanje y’ubwami, isi na yo ni indava y’ibirenge vyanje. Canke mwonyubakira inzu nyabaki? Ni ko Uhoraho abaza. Canke ikibanza canje co kuruhukiramwo coba hehe?
Mbega ukuboko kwanje si kwo kwaremye ivyo vyose?’
Mwa ntagondwa mwe! Imitima yanyu n’amatwi yanyu ntibirakebwa. Mumeze nka ba sogokuruza banyu: mwama mugarariza Mpwemu Yera.
Mbega hari umuvugishwa n’umwe ba sogokuruza banyu batahamye? Mbere bishe n’abavugishijwe ku kuza kwa wa Mugororotsi. None namwe ubu mwaramugurishije, muramwica,
kandi ari mwebwe mwakiriye ivyagezwe mubihawe n’abamarayika, ariko ntimwavyumvira.”
Abagize inama nkuru y’Abayuda bumvise ivyo, ishavu rirabarengera bashinga amenyo ku yandi kubera uburake.
Ariko Setefano yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, arangamiza mw’ijuru, abona ubwiza bw’Imana, abona na Yesu ahagaze i buryo bw’Imana.
Aca avuga ati: “Ehe mbonye ijuru ryugurutse, mbona n’Umwana w’Umuntu ahagaze i buryo bw’Imana.”
Ariko avuga uko, baca bazibira amatwi yabo kugira ntibamwumve, bashira urwamo hejuru, baca bamuhundarako icarimwe,
bamukwegera inyuma y’igisagara, batangura kumutera amabuye. Mu kumutera amabuye, abariko baramurega babanje kwikura imitamana yabo, biyirambika imbere y’ibirenge vy’umusore yitwa Sawuli.
Bakiriko baramutera amabuye, Setefano arasenga ati: “Mwami Yesu, akira ubugingo bwanje.”
Aca agwa apfukamye, asemerera ati: “Mwami, ntubaharureko iki caha.” Ahejeje kuvuga ivyo, aca aracikana.

headings.text: Setefano yiregura imbere y’Inama Nkuru y’Abayuda

verses.text: Na Sawuli ni ho yari ari kandi yari ashigikiye ko Setefano yicwa.
Abantu bubaha Imana baraza bahamba Setefano, kandi baramugandarira cane.
Ariko Sawuli we abandanya gusambura ishengero. Yinjira mu nzu ku yindi, afata abagabo n’abagore bizera asanzeyo, abata mw’ibohero.
Abo bashwiragiye bagenda barigisha ijambo ry’Imana aho baba bageze hose.
Nuko Filipo amanuka mu gisagara kimwe c’i Samariya, abwira abantu baho ivya Kristo.
Maze abantu benshi bamaze kwumva amajambo ya Filipo, bakabona n’ibitangaza akora, baca bashira umutima ku nyigisho ziwe.
Kuko abantu benshi baboshwe n’impwemu mbi barabohoka, izo mpwemu zikabavamwo zikoma induru, abanyunyutse n’abacumbagira bagakira.
Ivyo bituma haba umunezero mwinshi muri ico gisagara.
Hari umugabo yitwa Simoni yari amaze igihe ari umunyamareba muri ico gisagara, agatangaza ab’i Samariya bose,
kandi abantu bose, abahambaye n’aboroshe, baramutangarira bakavuga bati: “Uwu mugabo ni bwa bushobozi bw’Imana, bita ‘Ubushobozi Buhambaye.’ ”
Barakunda kumwumviriza kuko yari amaze igihe abatangaza n’amareba yiwe.
Ariko bamaze kwizera Ubutumwa Bwiza babwiwe na Filipo ku vyerekeye Ubwami bw’Imana n’izina rya Yesu Kristo, abagabo n’abagore benshi barabatizwa.
Na Simoni na we arabatizwa, aca aguma akurikira Filipo aho yaja hose, atangarira ibimenyetso n’ibitangaza Filipo akora.
Intumwa zari i Yerusalemu zumvise ko i Samariya abantu bakiriye Ijambo ry’Imana, baca barungika Petero na Yohana.
Bashitseyo, barabasengera kugira ngo baronke Mpwemu Yera,
kuko nta muntu n’umwe muri bo yari bwaronke Mpwemu Yera; bari babatijwe mw’izina ry’Umwami Yesu gusa.
Maze Petero na Yohana babarambikako ibiganza, baronka Mpwemu Yera.
Simoni abonye ko abantu baronka Mpwemu Yera barambitsweko ibiganza n’intumwa, aca abazanira amahera,
ababwira ati: “Nimumpe nanje ubwo bubasha kugira ngo uwo nzorambikako ibiganza azoronke Mpwemu Yera.”
Petero aramwishura ati: “Amahera yawe aragapfana na we, kuko wibaza ko woshobora kugura ingabire y’Imana amahera.
Nta n’agace canke umugabane ufise muri iki gikorwa, kuko umutima wawe utagororotse imbere y’Imana.
Nuko niwihane ivyo vyiyumviro bibi, usenge Umwami Imana. Kumbure yoguharira ivyo vyiyumviro bibi biri mu mutima wawe.
Kuko ndabona ko wuzuye umururazi, kandi ko uri umugurano w’ikibi.”
Simoni aca yishura ati: “Nsengera ku Mwami Imana kugira ngo ivyo uvuze vyose ntihagire na kimwe kizombako.”
Bamaze gushinga intahe no kuvuga Ijambo ry’Umwami Imana, Petero na Yohana baca basubira i Yerusalemu, bagenda baravuga Ubutumwa Bwiza mu mihana myinshi y’i Samariya.
Maze umumarayika w’Umwami Imana abarira Filipo ati: “Va hasi ufate inzira ija mu bumanuko, iva i Yerusalemu ija i Gaza ho mu bugaragwa.”
Nuko afata iyo nzira, akiriko aragenda ahura n’inkone y’Umunyetiyopiya, yari umutware akomeye, ajejwe ubutunzi bwa Kanidake, umwamikazi w’Abanyetiyopiya. Uwo muntu yari yagiye i Yerusalemu gusenga.
Ariko arataha, yicaye mu mukogote wiwe, yagenda arasoma igitabu c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya.
Mpwemu w’Imana abwira Filipo ati: “Egera uriya mukogote, uwugendere i ruhande.”
Nuko Filipo aranyaruka, agendera i ruhande y’uwo mukogote, yumva wa muntu ariko asoma igitabu c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Yesaya. Aramubaza ati: “Mbega ivyo uriko urasoma urabitahura?”
Na we aramwishura ati: “Nobitahura gute ata wubinsiguriye?” Aca asaba Filipo ngo yurire mu mukogote, baca baricarana.
Iyo nkone yariko isoma Ivyanditswe Vyera bivuga ngo: “Yatwawe nk’intama ijanwa kubagwa, atekereza nk’intama imbere y’uwuyimwa ubwoya, ntiyigeze akurako umunwa.
Yarateterejwe abura uwumurenganura. Ni nde yovuga ivy’uruvyaro rwiwe? Erega ubuzima bwiwe bwakuwe kw’isi.”
Maze iyo nkone ibaza Filipo iti: “Mbwira: uwu muntu uwavugishwa n’Imana avuga ko ni nde, ni we yivugako canke avuga ku wundi muntu?”
Filipo aca ahera kuri ivyo vyanditswe nyene, amubwira Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yesu.
Bakiri mu nzira bagenda, bashika ahantu hari amazi, ya nkone iravuga iti: “Ko hano hari amazi, ni igiki combuza kubatizwa?” [
Filipo aramwishura ati: “Niwaba wizeye n’umutima wawe wose, urashobora kubatizwa.” Na we arishura ati: “Ndizeye ko Yesu Kristo ari Umwana w’Imana.”]
Nuko aca ategeka ko bahagarika umukogote, barururuka baja mu mazi, Filipo aca aramubatiza.
Bavuye mu mazi, Mpwemu w’Imana aca ajana Filipo, ya nkone ntiyasubira kumubona, ariko aca abandanya urugendo anezerewe cane.
Filipo na we aca asubira kubonekera muri Azoto, ahaca agenda avuga Ubutumwa Bwiza mu bisagara vyose gushika ashitse i Kayisariya.

headings.text: Ihamwa ry’Ishengero no gusanzara kwaryo Uwo musi haca haduka ihamwa rikomeye kw’ishengero ry’i Yerusalemu, maze abigishwa bose, kiretse intumwa, barashwiragira, bamwe baja i Yudaya abandi baja n’i Samariya.

verses.text: Ico gihe Sawuli yari ageramiye abigishwa b’Umwami Yesu, ahiga kubica. Nuko aja ku muherezi mukuru,
amusaba amakete atwara mu masinagogi y’i Damasiko, kugira ngo nihagira abo asanga bakurikira inzira y’Umwami Yesu, baba abagabo canke abagore, ace abatwara nk’imbohe i Yerusalemu.
Akigenda, yegereje i Damasiko, umuco uvuye mw’ijuru umurasirako giturumbuka impande zose.
Aca agwa hasi, yumva ijwi rimubwira riti: “Sawuli, Sawuli, uriko umpamira iki?”
Na we arabaza ati: “Uri nde ga Mwami?” Iryo jwi na ryo riti: “Ndi Yesu, uwo uriko urahama.
Ariko haguruka ushike mu gisagara, ni ho uzobwirirwa ivyo ukwiye gukora.”
Abari kumwe na Sawuli bahagarara bumiwe, kuko bumva ijwi ariko batabona uwuvuga.
Sawuli ava hasi, ariko agerageje gukanura, ntiyashobora kubona. Baca bamufata ukuboko bamutwara i Damasiko,
ahamara imisi itatu atabona, ata co arya kandi ata co anywa.
I Damasiko hariho umwigishwa wa Yesu yitwa Ananiya. Maze Umwami Yesu aramwiyereka mu nzozi, aramuhamagara ati: “Ananiya!” Na we arishura ati: “Sabwe Mwami!”
Umwami Yesu aramubwira ati: “Haguruka uje kw’ibarabara ryitwa irigororotse, ushitse i muhira kwa Yuda, ubaze bakwereke umugabo yitwa Sawuli ava i Taruso, kuko ni ho ari ariko arasenga.
Kandi mu nzozi, yabonye umuntu yitwa Ananiya aza kumurambikako ibiganza kugira ngo ahumuke.”
Ananiya aca aramwishura ati: “Mwami, narumvise benshi bavuga ivy’uwo muntu n’amabi yakoreye abera bawe i Yerusalemu.
Kandi yaje hano afise ububasha yahawe n’abaherezi bakurubakuru kugira ngo afate abo bose bambaza izina ryawe.”
Ariko Umwami Yesu yishura Ananiya ati: “Genda, kuko uwo Sawuli ari igikoresho natoranije kugira ngo amenyekanishe izina ryanje mu Banyamahanga n’abami babo, ndetse n’abo mu Bisirayeli.
Kandi jewe ubwanje nzomwereka imibabaro yose akwiye kuzobabazwa ku bw’izina ryanje.”

Nuko Ananiya aca aragenda arinjira muri iyo nzu. Maze aca arambika ibiganza kuri Sawuli, avuga ati: “Mwene Data Sawuli, Umwami Yesu, uwakwiyeretse uri mu nzira uza, yakuntumyeko kugira ngo uhumuke kandi wuzure Mpwemu Yera.”
Ubwo nyene, ibintu bimeze nk’ibikaragashi biva ku maso ya Sawuli, arahumuka. Ubwo nyene aca ava hasi arabatizwa.
Nuko ahejeje gufungura, inguvu zongera kugaruka.
Maze atangura kwigisha mu masinagogi ko Yesu ari Umwana w’Imana.

Abamwumva bose baratangara, bakabazanya bati: “Mbega uwu mugabo si umwe yahora atikiza abasenga izina rya Yesu i Yerusalemu? Mbega ntiyari yazanywe ino no gufata abizera kugira ngo abatware nk’imbohe ku baherezi bakurubakuru?”
Ariko inyigisho za Sawuli zirushiriza kugira ubushobozi mu kwemeza Abayuda b’i Damasiko ko Yesu ari we Kristo kuko zatuma bataronka n’ico basubizayo.
Haciye igihe, Abayuda barondera ingena bomwica,
ariko Sawuli amenya imigambi yabo mibi. Ijoro n’umurango bama bamutegereye ku marembo y’igisagara kugira ngo bamwice.
Ijoro rimwe, bamwe mu Bigishwa bamushira mu giseke, bamucisha mw’idirisha ry’uruzitiro rw’igisagara, bamwururukiriza inyuma.
Ashitse i Yerusalemu, agomba kwifatanya n’abandi bigishwa, ariko bose baramutinya, kuko batizera ko yahindutse umwigishwa vy’ukuri.
Ariko Baranaba aramufata amujana ku ntumwa, abasigurira ingene Sawuli yahuye n’Umwami Yesu ari mu nzira aja i Damasiko akavugana na we, n’ingene i Damasiko yigishije mw’izina rya Yesu ata bwoba.
Maze Sawuli aca agumana n’intumwa i Yerusalemu yidegemvya, yigisha ashize amanga mw’izina rya Yesu.
Yama avugana yongera aharira n’Abayuda bavuga Ikigiriki, ariko bo bakama barondera ingene bomwica.
Abizera Kristo babimenye, baca bamumanukana i Kayisariya, bamurungika i Taruso.
Ico gihe, Ishengero ry’i Yudaya, i Galilaya n’i Samariya rigira amahoro, rirakomera, kuko abizera bagendera mu kwubaha Umwami Imana. Kandi kubera ritewe intege na Mpwemu Yera riragwira mu gitigiri.
Nuko Petero agendagenda muri izo ntara zose, hanyuma amanuka kuramutsa abizera b’i Luda.
Maze, ahasanga umugabo yitwa Ayineya, yari amaze imyaka umunani yose adashobora kuva ku buriri kuko yari yarakongataye.
Hanyuma Petero aca aramubwira ati: “Ayineya, Yesu Kristo aragukijije. Haguruka uzinge ikirago cawe.” Ubwo nyene Ayineya aca arahaguruka.
Ababa i Luda n’i Sharoni bose bamubonye agendagenda, baca barihana bizera Umwami Yesu.
Kandi i Yopa hariho umwigishwa yitwa Tabita (mu Kigiriki risobanurwa ngo Dorukasi, ni ukuvuga Ingeregere), yama akora ibikorwa vyiza, agafasha abakene.
Muri iyo misi aragwara, hanyuma arapfa. Ikiziga ciwe baracoza, bakibika mu cumba co hejuru.
Kubera i Luda n’i Yopa hari hegeranye, abigishwa b’i Yopa bumvise ko Petero ari i Luda, bamutumako abagabo babiri bati: “Turakwinginze ushike iwacu udatevye.”

Nuko Petero arahaguruka ajana na bo. Bashitse baca bamutwara muri ico cumba co hejuru. Abapfakazi bose baraza bakikuza Petero bariko bararira, bamwereka amakanzu n’izindi mpuzu Dorukasi yari yarabakoreye akiri kumwe na bo.
Maze Petero arabataramura bose, aca arapfukama arasenga. Hanyuma ahindukirira ikiziga, avuga ati: “Tabita, vyuka!” Nuko Tabita arakanura. Abonye Petero, aca aravyuka aricara.
Petero aca amufata ukuboko aramuhagurutsa. Hanyuma ahamagara abizera, na canecane abapfakazi, amubashikiriza ari muzima.
Maze iyo nkuru ica yamamara i Yopa hose, kandi abantu benshi bizera Umwami Yesu.
Petero aca amara imisi myinshi i Yopa kwa Simoni, yakora ivyo gutunganya insato.

headings.text: Sawuli yigisha i Damasiko n’i Yerusalemu Nuko Sawuli amarana imisi n’abigishwa i Damasiko.

verses.text: I Kayisariya hariho umugabo yitwa Koruneliyo, yari umugabisha w’umuce w’ingabo bita Umuce w’Abataliyano.
We n’umuryango wiwe bari bariyeguriye kwubaha Imana. Yaratanga ivyiwe abifashisha aboro, kandi agasenga ubudasiba.
Umusi umwe, hari nk’igihe c’isaha cenda z’umuhingamo, yerekwa abona mu buryo bugarara umumarayika w’Imana yinjiye aho ari, maze avuga ati: “Koruneliyo!”

Koruneliyo na we amuhanga amaso yuzuye ubwoba, aramubaza ati: “Ni iki ga Mwami?” Uwo mumarayika aramwishura ati: “Amasengesho yawe n’ibikorwa vyawe vyo gufasha abakene vyaduze imbere y’Imana biba ishikanwa ry’icibutso.
Nuko rero rungika abantu i Yopa, bazane umugabo yitwa Simoni ari we Petero.
Ari kumwe na Simoni, akora ivyo gutunganya insato, inzu yiwe iri ku nkengera y’ikiyaga.”
Wa mumarayika baganira amaze kugenda, Koruneliyo aca ahamagara babiri mu bakozi bari kumwe hamwe n’umusoda yubaha Imana, umwe mu bamugendanira.
Nuko ababwira ivyabaye vyose aca abatuma i Yopa.
Bukeye, nk’igihe c’isaha zitandatu z’umurango, ba bantu bakiri mu nzira bagira bashike i Yopa, Petero aduga hejuru ku gisenge c’inzu gusenga.
Hanyuma arasonza, ashaka ico arya. Bakiriko barategura infungurwa, aca aja mu vyo kwerekwa.
Abona ijuru ryugurutse, abona ikintu kimeze nk’igitambara kinini cururutswa hasi gifashwe ku mitwe yaco uko ari ine.
Carimwo ibikoko vy’ubwoko bwose bigendera ku maguru ane, ibikwega inda hasi, hamwe n’ibiguruka mu kirere.
Maze yumva ijwi rimubwira riti: “Petero we, haguruka, ubage, urye.”
Petero na we yishura ati: “Oyaye Mwami, ntibikabe! Kuko jewe ntigeze ndya ikintu na kimwe gihumanye.”
Rya jwi ryongera kumubwira ubwa kabiri riti: “Ico Imana yahumanuye ntukacite igihumanye.”
Ivyo biba incuro zitatu, ca gitambara gica gisubira kuduzwa mw’ijuru.
Petero akiriko ariyumvira insobanuro y’ivyo yeretswe, ba bantu bavuye kwa Koruneliyo baba barashitse kuri ya nzu ya Simoni, bahagarara kw’irembo.
Maze barahamagara babaza ko Simoni yitwa Petero yoba ari ho asavye indaro.
Petero akiriko ariyumvira kuri bimwe yerekwa, Mpwemu Yera aramubwira ati: “Simoni, hari abantu batatu bariko barakurondera.
Haguruka wururuke kandi ntutinye kujana na bo kuko ari jewe nabarungitse.”
Petero arururuka, abwira ba bantu ati: “Ni jewe muriko murarondera. Muzanywe n’iki?”

Ba bantu barishura bati: “Turungitswe na Koruneliyo, umugabisha w’abasoda ijana. Ni umugororotsi yubaha Imana, ashingirwa intahe n’ubwoko bw’Abayuda bwose. Umumarayika yamubwiye ngo agutumeko iwe kugira ngo yumve ivyo uri bumubwire.”
Nuko Petero aca arabakira ngo barare ngaho.
Ku musi ukurikira barashika i Kayisariya, kandi Koruneliyo mu kubarindira, yari yakoranije incuti n’abagenzi biwe.
Petero ashitse mu nzu, Koruneliyo aca akubita ibipfukamiro hasi ngo amusenge.
Ariko Petero aramubwira ati: “Haguruka kuko nanje ndi umuntu nka we!”
Nuko bagenda baraganira berekeje aho abantu benshi bari bari.

Maze Petero aca ababwira ati: “Murazi neza ko amategeko y’idini ryacu atemerera Umuyuda kwifatanya n’umunyamahanga canke ngo amugendere. Ariko Imana yanyeretse ko ntakwiye gufata umuntu n’umwe nk’uwuhumanye.
Ni co gituma igihe mwantumako nemeye kuza ntahigimanze. Nagomba rero kubaza icatumye muntumako.”
Koruneliyo aramwishura ati: “Haciye imisi itatu, nari iwanje ndiko ndasenga, hari nk’igihe c’isaha icenda. Hanyuma mbona umuntu yambaye impuzu zikayangana ahagaze imbere yanje
ambarira ati: ‘Koruneliyo, Imana yumvise amasengesho yawe, kandi yibutse n’ibikorwa vyawe vyo gufasha aboro.
Tumako Simoni bita Petero, ari i Yopa. Asavye indaro mu nzu kwa Simoni akora umwuga wo gutunganya insato, aba ku nkengera y’ikiyaga.’
Ni ko guca ndagutumako ubwo nyene, kandi wagize neza kuza. None rero ubu twese turi hano imbere y’Imana kugira ngo twumve ivyo Imana yagutumye kutubwira vyose.”
Nuko rero Petero aherako avuga ati: “Ubu rero ni ho nkimenya vy’ukuri ko Imana idatoranya abantu ku butoni,
ariko ko mu mahanga yose umuntu wese ayubaha agakora ibigororotse imwemera.
Murazi ijambo Imana yarungikiye Abisirayeli, ryavuga inkuru nziza y’amahoro abonerwa muri Yesu Kristo, ari we Mwami wa bose.
Murazi ivyabaye i Yudaya hose, uhereye i Galilaya inyuma y’umubatizo Yohana yigisha;
ingene Imana yarobanuje Yesu w’i Nazareti Mpwemu Yera n’ubushobozi, n’ukuntu yagendagenda hose agira neza, akiza abari mu gacinyizo ka wa mubi, kuko Imana yari kumwe na we.
Natwe turi ivyabona vyo gushingira intahe ivyo yakoze vyose mu gihugu c’Abayuda n’i Yerusalemu. Yishwe abambwe ku musaraba,
ariko Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye ku musi ugira gatatu, ituma asubira kuboneka.
Ntiyabonywe na bose, kiretse twebwe abo Imana yari yaratoranije nk’ivyabona, twasangiye na we ivyokurya n’ibinyobwa amaze kuzuka mu bapfuye.
Kandi yadutumye kwigisha abantu no gushinga intahe ko ari we Imana yashizeho ngo abe umucamanza w’abazima n’abapfuye.
Abavugishwa n’Imana bose baramushingira intahe ko uwumwizeye wese azoharirwa ivyaha mw’izina ryiwe.”
Petero akiriko aravuga ayo majambo, Mpwemu Yera amanukira ku bumvise ubwo butumwa bose.
Abizera bo mu bakebwe bari bazananye na Petero batangazwa cane n’uko ingabire ya Mpwemu Yera yasutswe no ku Banyamahanga na bo,
kuko babumvise bavuga mu ndimi zitamenyekana, bahimbaza Imana. Maze Petero aca avuga ati:
“Mbega hari uwobuza aba bantu kubatizwa mu mazi, kandi baronse Mpwemu Yera nk’uko natwe twamuronse?”
Nuko asaba ko bababatiza mw’Izina rya Yesu Kristo. Baca binginga Petero ngo amarane na bo imisi na mikeya.

headings.text: Petero yigisha mu nzu kwa Koruneliyo Bukeye Petero ajana na bo, aherekejwe na bamwe bo mu bizera b’i Yopa.

verses.text: Intumwa n’abandi bizera b’i Yudaya bumva ko Abanyamahanga na bo bakiriye ijambo ry’Imana.
Maze Petero asubiye i Yerusalemu, abizera bakebwe ari bo Bayuda baramunegura,
bati: “Wewe warinjiye mu nzu y’abatakebwe, mbere warasangiye na bo!”
Nuko Petero ahera ku ntango, abasigurira neza vyose uko vyagenze. Arababwira ati:

“Nari i Yopa ndiko ndasenga, hanyuma mera nk’uwutwawe n’agatiro, nca ntangura kwerekwa. Mbona ikintu kimeze nk’igitambara kinini cururuka kiva mw’ijuru gifashwe ku mitwe yaco uko ari ine, gishika aho nari ndi.
Nihweje muri co, mbona ibikoko bigendera ku maguru ane, inyamaswa zo mw’ishamba, ibikwega inda hasi hamwe n’ibiguruka mu kirere.
Nca numva ijwi rimbarira riti: ‘Petero we, haguruka, ubage urye.’
Nanje ndishura nti: ‘Oyaye Mwami, ntibikabe! Kuko jewe ntigeze ndya ikintu na kimwe gihumanye.’
Rya jwi ryongera kuvuga ubwa kabiri rivuye mw’ijuru riti: ‘Ico Imana yahumanuye ntukacite igihumanye.’
Ivyo biba incuro zitatu, ca gitambara gica gisubira kuduzwa mw’ijuru.
Ubwo nyene abantu batatu bantumweko bavuye i Kayisariya baba barashitse imbere y’inzu nari natsemwo indaro.
Mpwemu Yera ambarira ko nojana na bo ntakekeranije. Aba bene Data batandatu baramperekeje i Kayisariya, maze twese twinjira kwa Koruneliyo,
na we aca atubwira ko yabonye umumarayika ahagaze mu nzu iwe amubwira ati: ‘Rungika abantu i Yopa bazane umuntu yitwa Simoni ari we Petero.
Azokuzanira ubutumwa buzogukizanya n’abo mu nzu yawe bose.’
Ntanguye kuvuga, Mpwemu Yera abazako nk’uko yatujeko mu ntango.
Nca nibuka ivyo Umwami Yesu yavuze, ati: ‘Yohana yabatiza mu mazi, ariko mwebwe muzobatizwa muri Mpwemu Yera.’
None rero nimba Imana yabahaye ingabire nk’iyo yaduhaye, twebwe twizeye Umwami Yesu Kristo, mbega jewe nari iki ngo mbe intambamyi ku gikorwa c’Imana?”
Bavyumvise ntibagira ico basubizayo, ahubwo bashima Imana, bavuga bati: “Erega noneho Imana ihaye Abanyamahanga na bo akaryo ko kwihana ivyaha vyabo ngo baronke ubugingo budashira.”
Nuko abari barasabagiye kubera ihamwa ryari ryatanguranye n’urupfu rwa Setefano baragenda gushika i Foyinike, i Kupuro no muri Antiyokiya, babwira ijambo ry’Imana Abayuda bonyene.
Ariko bamwe muri bo, abava i Kupuro n’i Kurene, baja muri Antiyokiya, batangura kwigisha n’Abagiriki na bo, bababwira Ubutumwa Bwiza bw’Umwami Yesu Kristo.
Ikiganza c’Umwami Imana cari kuri bo, bituma abantu benshi bizera, bahindukirira Umwami Yesu.
Inkuru zabo zishikira ishengero ry’i Yerusalemu, maze barungika Baranaba muri Antiyokiya.
Ashitseyo akibonera ico ubuntu bw’Imana bwakoze, aranezerwa cane, yongera arabinginga bose ngo bashishikare gukurikira Umwami n’imitima yabo yose.
Baranaba yari umuntu w’umugwaneza, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera n’ukwizera. Nuko igitigiri kinini c’abantu bizera Umwami Yesu.
Inyuma y’aho Baranaba aca aja i Taruso kurondera Sawuli.
Amubonye, aca amujana muri Antiyokiya, bompi bamarana umwaka n’ishengero, bigisha abantu benshi cane. Aho muri Antiyokiya ni ho abigishwa batanguriye kwitwa Abakristo.
Muri ico gihe, abavugishwa n’Imana bamwe bamanutse bava i Yerusalemu, baja muri Antiyokiya.
Umwe muri bo yitwa Agabo, arahaguruka, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, avuga ko ikigoyi kizotera mu bwami bw’Abaroma bwose. (Ivyo vyahavuye bishika ku ngoma ya Korode.)
Nuko abigishwa bo muri Antiyokiya, bivanye n’ico umwumwe wese ashoboye, bafata ingingo yo kurungikira imfashanyo abizera b’i Yudaya.
Nuko barabishitsa, barungikira imfashanyo zabo abakuru b’ishengero ry’i Yerusalemu, zijanwa na Baranaba na Sawuli.

headings.text: Petero yisigura ku vyabereye kwa Koruneliyo

verses.text: Muri ico gihe, ni ho umwami Herode Agiripa yatangura gufata bamwe mu bo mw’isheshengero, atangura kubahama.
Nuko afata Yakobo, yavukana na Yohana, amwicisha inkota.
Abonye binejereje Abayuda, afata na Petero. Ivyo vyabaye mu gihe c’imisi mikuru y’imikate itarimwo umwambiro.
Amaze kumufata, amushira mw’ibohero amuha imigwi ine y’abasoda bane bane bakuranwa kumurinda. Herode yagomba kuzomucira urubanza ku mugaragaro inyuma ya Pasika.
Nuko Petero ashirwa mw’ibohero, ariko ishengero riguma risenga Imana n’umwete mwinshi ku bwiwe.
Buca Herode amucira urubanza, Petero yari asinziriye, aryamye hagati y’abasoda babiri, abohesheje iminyororo ibiri. Abandi basoda bari baraririye ku muryango w’ibohero.
Umumarayika w’Umwami Imana aca araza, umuco urasira mu cumba Petero yarimwo, amukoma mu rubavu, aramukangura, amubwira ati: “Vyuka ningoga!” Ubwo nyene ya minyororo ica imuva ku bikonjo, irakoroka.
Uwo mumarayika aca abarira Petero ati: “Ambara impuzu n’ibirato vyawe.” Nuko Petero aravyambara. Wa mumarayika arasubira ati: “Ambara umutamana wawe, unkurikire.”
Maze Petero aca aramukurikira barasohoka, ariko ntiyari azi ko ivyo uwo mumarayika ariko arakora vyari ivy’ukuri. Yiyumvira ko yariko arerekwa.

Nuko baca ku bararirizi ba mbere n’aba kabiri, bashika no ku rugi rw’irembo ryaja mu gisagara, rwari urw’icuma. Maze ruriyugurura, bararengana, barasohoka. Bagishika mw’ibarabara, wa mumarayika asiga ngaho Petero, ntiyasubira kumubona.
Ni ho Petero yatora akenge, avuga ati: “Ubu rero ndamenye vy’ukuri ko Umwami Imana yarungitse umumarayika kundokora mu vyara vya Herode n’ivyo Abayuda bari bateguye kungirira vyose.”
Amaze gutahura ivyo, aca aja i muhira kwa Mariya nyina wa Yohana ari we Mariko, aho abizera benshi bari bakoraniye bariko barasenga.
Petero aradodora ku rugi rwo kw’irembo, umukobwa w’umuguranokazi yitwa Roda aca aza kuraba uwudodoye.
Yumvise ijwi rya Petero, aranezerwa cane, aca asubira inyuma yiruka atuguruye, avuga ati: “Ni Petero ari kw’irembo!”
Baca bamubwira bati: “Na mba wataye ubwenge!” Ariko babonye ashishikaye kuvyemeza, baca bavuga bati: “Ashobora kuba ari umumarayika wiwe!”
Petero ashishikara kudodora, buguruye urugi basanga ni we, baratangara cane.
Petero aca arabamama ngo batekereze, aca abiganira ido n’ido ukuntu Umwami Imana yamukuye mw’ibohero. Arababwira ati: “Murabibwira Yakobo n’abandi bene Data.” Aca ava aho aragenda.
Bukeye, haba uruhagarara hagati y’abasoda, bibaza ivyashikiye Petero.
Herode Agiripa amaze kumurondeza hose bakamubura, aca agira itohoza mu basoda, aca ategeka ko babica.

Yari amaze igihe atumvikana n’abantu b’i Tiro n’i Sidoni, maze na bo baja hamwe bamusaba umubonano. Bafashijwe na Bulasito, umukuru w’abategura icumba c’umwami, basaba kugiranira amasezerano y’amahoro, kuko ivyo bihugu vyasumira mu bwami Herode Agiripa yatwara.
Isango rigeze, Herode yambara ikanzu y’inyambarabami, yicara ku ntebe y’ubwami, abwira ijambo abari ngaho.
Maze abantu basemererera rimwe bavuga bati: “Iyi ni imana ivuze, si umuntu.”
Ariko, kubera Herode Agiripa atahesheje Imana icubahiro, akemera ko abantu bamuninahaza, ubwo nyene umumarayika aca aramukubita, aribwa n’inyo, aca arapfa.
Nuko ijambo ry’Imana rica rirashishikara kugwira no kwamamara.
Baranaba na Sawuli baheraheza igikorwa cabo, baca bava i Yerusalemu, bagenda bajanye na Yohana, ari we Mariko.

headings.text: Urupfu rwa Herode Agiripa Maze Herode aca ava i Yudaya yigira i Kayisariya, amarayo igihe.

verses.text: Mw’ishengero ryo muri Antiyokiya hari abavugishwa n’Imana n’abigisha ari bo Baranaba, Simeyoni bita Mwirabure, Lukiyo Umunyakurene, Manayeni yari yakuranye na Herode Antipa, hamwe na Sawuli.
Bariko barasenga Imana bisonzesheje, Mpwemu Yera ababarira ati: “Ntoraniriza Baranaba na Sawuli, bankorere igikorwa nabahamagariye.”
Bahejeje kwisonzesha no gusenga, baca babarambikako ibiganza, barabarungika.
Nuko baragenda batumwe na Mpwemu Yera, bamanuka i Seluwukiya, baca bafata ubwato buja mw’izinga ryitwa Kupuro.
Bageze i Salamini bavuga ijambo ry’Imana mu masinagogi y’Abayuda, kandi Yohana Mariko yagendana na bo abakorera.
Nuko bagendagenda iryo zinga ryose gushika bashitse i Pafo. Aho bahahuriye n’Umuyuda w’umunyamareba yigira umuvugishwa, yitwa Bari Yesu,
yagendanira Serejiyo Pawulo, yaserukira Kayisari aho hantu; uwo yari umuntu w’umunyabwenge. Nuko Serejiyo Pawulo atumako Baranaba na Sawuli, kugira ngo yumve ijambo ry’Imana.
Ariko wa munyamareba Eluma (izina ryiwe ni ko risobanurwa mu Kigiriki), arabahaririza agomba guhuvya ukwizera kw’uwo aserukira Kayisari.
Maze Sawuli, ari we yitwa Pawulo, yuzuye Mpwemu Yera, amuhanga amaso,
amubwira ati: “Wa mwana wa wa mubi we, umwansi w’ivyiza vyose! Uzogeza ryari kubuza abantu kugororokera Umwami?

Noneho rero Imana ibanguye ukuboko ngo iguhane. Ugiye guhuma, kandi kuva ubu ntuzosubira kubona umuco w’izuba.” Ubwo nyene amaso yiwe aca yuzura umwijima, amera nk’uwo bwiriyeko, atangura kujuragirika mu mpande zose arondera uwomufata ukuboko.
Maze uwo aserukira Kayisari abonye ibibaye arizera kuko yari atangajwe cane n’izo nyigisho zavuga ivy’Umwami Yesu.
Bavuye i Pafo, Pawulo n’abo bari kumwe baca bafata ubwato baja i Pamfiliya ahitwa Peruga, Yohana Mariko aca abasigaho asubira i Yerusalemu.
Hanyuma bava i Peruga baja muri Antiyokiya h’i Pisidiya. Ku musi w’Isabato baja mw’isinagogi baricara.
Bahejeje gusoma mu gitabu c’Ivyagezwe n’abavugishwa n’Imana, abakuru b’isinagogi baca batuma umuntu ababaza ati: “Bene Data, nimwaba mufise ijambo ryo gutera intege abantu, nimuhaguruke mwigishe.”
Pawulo ahagurutse, arabamama ngo bacereze, maze ababwira ati: “Yemwe Bisirayeli namwe Banyamahanga mwubaha Imana, muntege amatwi!
Imana y’ubwoko bwa Isirayeli ni yo yatoranije ba sogokuruza, ibaha kuba ihanga rikomeye mu gihugu c’Abanyamahanga Egiputa, hanyuma ibakuzayo ukuboko kwayo kw’ubushobozi,
yihanganira ubugaba bwabo imyaka mirongo ine mu bugaragwa.
Yaranduye amahanga indwi yo mu gihugu c’i Kanani, igiha ubwoko bwacu ngo bucegukire.
Ivyo vyose vyabaye nko mu kiringo c’imyaka amajana ane na mirongo itanu. Inyuma y’ivyo Imana yabahaye abacamanza gushika mu gihe c’uwavugishwa n’Imana Samweli.
Ariko mu nyuma bayisaba umwami, na yo ibaha Sawuli mwene Kishi, yava mu muryango wa Benyamini, abaganza imyaka mirongo ine.
Imaze gukura Sawuli, yimitse Dawidi ngo abe umwami wabo. Yamushingiye intahe iti: ‘Nironkeye Dawidi mwene Isayi, umuntu ahuye n’uko umutima wanje ugomba, azoshitsa ivyo ngomba vyose.’
Mu ruvyaro rw’uwo muntu, ni ho Imana yacishije Yesu, umukiza w’Abisirayeli, nk’uko yari yarabisezeranye.
Imbere y’ukuza kwa Yesu, Yohana yigisha ukwihana n’ukubatizwa ku bantu bose b’Abisirayeli.
Yohana ariko araheraheza igikorwa ciwe, yavuze ati: ‘Mwibaza ko ndi nde? Sindi wa wundi mwiteze, haba na mba. Ariko hari uwuje inyuma yanje; ntibimbereye no gupfundurura utugozi tw’ibirato vyiwe.’
Bene Data, buzukuruza ba Aburahamu, namwe Banyamahanga mwubaha Imana, ni twebwe ubu butumwa bw’agakiza bwarungikiwe.
Ababa i Yerusalemu n’abatware babo ntibamenye Yesu, ariko baramutsindishije, baba bashikije amajambo y’abavugishwa n’Imana yama asomwa ku musi w’Isabato.
Naho ata camwagira cari gutuma bamucira urubanza rwo gupfa, basavye Pilato kumwicisha.
Bamaze gushitsa ivyanditswe kuri we vyose, bamumanuye ku musaraba bamushira mu mva.
Ariko Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye,
hanyuma amara imisi myinshi yiyereka abagendanye na we kuva i Galilaya gushika i Yerusalemu. Ubu ni bo bariko baramushingira intahe mu bwoko bwacu.
Natwe rero turi ngaha tubabwira iyi nkuru nziza: Ico Imana yasezeraniye ba sogokuruza
yagishikije ku bwacu, twebwe abana babo, mu kuzura Yesu mu bapfuye. Ibi ni vyo vyanditswe muri Zaburi ya kabiri ngo: ‘Uri umwana wanje; uwu musi ndakuvyaye.’
Imana yaramuzuye mu bapfuye kugira ngo ntaze yigere abora. Imana yabivuze muri aya majambo, iti: ‘Nzobaha imigisha itunganye kandi idahinduka, iyo nasezeraniye Dawidi.’
Ahandi naho havuga ngo: ‘Ntuzoreka uwera wawe ngo abore.’
Dawidi amaze gukora ivyo Imana igomba mu gihe ciwe, yarasinziriye, ahambwa hamwe na ba sekuruza, umubiri wiwe urabora.
Ariko uwo Imana yazuye mu bapfuye ntiyigeze abora.
None rero bene Data, turabamenyesha ko ari muri Yesu mumenyesherezwa inkuru yo guharirwa ivyaha.
Muri we, uwizera wese aba abohowe icaha ciwe cose, ari kwo kwemerwa n’Imana nk’abagororotsi, ukwo mutashobora guhabwa n’Ivyagezwe vya Mose.
Mwiyubare rero kugira ngo ivyo abavugishwa bavuze ntibibashikeko, aho bavuga ngo:
‘Nimwitegereze, mwa bacokoranyi mwe, mutangare maze muzimangane. Kuko mu gihe canyu ngiye gukora kintu, mutokwigera mwemera, naho hogira uwukibabwira.’”
Mu gihe Pawulo na Baranaba bariko barasohoka bava mw’isinagogi, abantu barabinginga ngo bazogaruke ku musi w’Isabato ikurikira kugira ngo bashishikare kwigisha kuri ayo majambo.
Abantu bamaze gutaha, benshi bo mw’isinagogi y’Abayuda hamwe n’abandi bizeye Imana bakurikira Pawulo na Baranaba, na bo bagenda barabahimiriza ngo bagume mu buntu bw’Imana.
Ku musi w’Isabato ukurikira, igisagara nka cose cari cakoranye ngo bumvirize ijambo ry’Umwami Imana.
Abayuda babonye ayo masinzi bagira ishari, batangura kuvuga ibinyuranye n’ivyo Pawulo yariko aravuga, banamutuka.

Pawulo na Baranaba baca barabishura ata bwoba bati: “Ni mwebwe mwari mukwiye kwumva ijambo ry’Imana ubwa mbere. Ariko ko muryanse, mukabona ko mutabereye ubugingo budashira, duhindukiriye Abanyamahanga.
Kuko Umwami yari yadutegetse ati: ‘Nagushiriyeho kuba umuco ku Banyamahanga, kugira ngo uzoshikane agakiza ku mpera z’isi.’”
Abanyamahanga bavyumvise baranezerwa cane, bahimbaza Ijambo ry’Umwami Imana; abari baratoranirijwe ubugingo budashira, barizera.
Nuko ijambo ry’Imana ryamamara muri iyo ntara yose.
Ariko Abayuda bosha abagore b’icubahiro bubaha Imana, hamwe n’abagabo baganza igisagara, batangura guhama Pawulo na Baranaba, babirukana muri iyo ntara.
Pawulo na Baranaba na bo bakunkumura umukungugu wo mu birenge vyabo, baca baja muri Ikoniyo.
Kandi abigishwa bo muri Antiyokiya bari bafise umunezero mwinshi, buzuye Mpwemu Yera.

headings.text: Pawulo na Baranaba bashika muri Antiyokiya h’i Pisidiya

verses.text: Muri Ikoniyo, Pawulo na Baranaba binjira mw’isinagogi nk’uko bahora babigenza. Maze bavuga Ubutumwa Bwiza bwuzuye bashize amanga, bituma Abayuda n’Abanyamahanga benshi bizera.
Ariko Abayuda banse kwizera bagumura abandi Banyamahanga babatera kwanka abizera.
Maze Pawulo na Baranaba bahamara igihe kitari gito, bavugira Umwami Yesu bashize amanga, na we agashingira intahe Ubutumwa bw’Ubuntu bavuga, mu kubakoresha ibitangaza n’utwumiza.
Ivyo vyatumye abantu bo muri ico gisagara bicamwo imigwi, bamwe begamira Abayuda, abandi begamira intumwa.
Mu nyuma, Abayuda n’Abanyamahanga bamwe, bari kumwe n’abatware babo, baja inama yo kugirira nabi intumwa no kuzicisha amabuye.
Intumwa zibimenye, zica zihungira mu bisagara vya Lusitira na Derube biri i Lukawoniya, no mu micungararo.
N’aho nyene babandanije bahavuga Ubutumwa Bwiza.
I Lusitira hari umugabo yama yicaye kuko yari amugaye ibirenge. Yari yavutse amugaye, ntiyari yarigeze atambuka.
Nuko yumviriza Pawulo ariko arigisha, Pawulo na we aramwihweza, abona afise ukwizera kwotuma akira.
Pawulo aca avuga n’ijwi rirenga ati: “Haguruka, uhagarare ku birenge vyawe!” Ubwo nyene wa mugabo aca arabaduka, aca atangura gutambuka.
Ishengero ribonye ivyo Pawulo akoze, bavuga n’amajwi arenga mu Kinyalukawoniya bati: “imana zadushwayemwo zambaye imibiri y’abantu!”
Baranaba bamwita Zeyusi, Pawulo na we bamwita Heremesi, kuko ari we yigisha kenshi.
Maze umuherezi wa Zeyusi azana impfizi z’inka n’ingori z’amashurwe kw’irembo ry’igisagara; aho ni ho hari ingoro y’iyo mana. We n’iryo sinzi ry’abantu bagomba gushikanira ibimazi izo ntumwa.
Ariko Pawulo na Baranaba bavyumvise, bitabagurirako impuzu, biruka mu bantu basemerera bati:

“Mbega bagenzi, ivyo bintu mubikora kubera iki? Erega turi abantu nka mwebwe! Twabazaniye Ubutumwa Bwiza, bubabwira guhindukira mukava mu bitagira ikimazi, mukaza ku Mana nzima, yaremye ijuru, isi n’ikiyaga, n’ibibibamwo vyose.
Mu bihe vyaheze, yaretse amahanga yose ngo yigenze uko yipfuza.
Ariko ntiyigeze ihengeshanya kubiyereka mu vyiza yabakorera: ikabaha imvura iva mw’ijuru n’umwimbu mwinshi mu gihe cavyo, ikabaha ivyokurya bikwiye, ikuzuza imitima yanyu umunezero.”
Naho Pawulo yari avuze amajambo nk’ayo, intumwa vyarazigoye kubabuza kuzishikanira ibimazi.
Maze haca haza Abayuda bari bavuye i Antiyokiya no muri Ikoniyo, bosha abari aho bose, batera amabuye Pawulo, bamukwegera inyuma y’igisagara bibwira ko yapfuye.
Ariko abandi bigishwa bamaze kuza bakegeranira aho yari ari, aca arahaguruka, asubira mu gisagara. Bukeye we na Baranaba baca barahava, baja i Derube.
Nuko bavuga Ubutumwa Bwiza muri ico gisagara kandi baharonka igitigiri kinini c’abigishwa. Hanyuma baca basubira i Lusitira, muri Ikoniyo no muri Antiyokiya
binginga abigishwa ngo bagume bahagaze mu kwizera. Bababwira bati: “Dutegerezwa guca mu bitubabaza vyinshi kugira twinjire mu Bwami bw’Imana.”
Pawulo na Baranaba, bamaze gusenga no kwisonzesha, baca bagena abakuru b’amashengero yose, babaragiza Umwami Yesu bari bizeye.
Nuko baca baca muri Pisidiya bashika i Pamfiliya.
Bavuga ijambo ry’Imana i Peruga, baca bamanuka muri Ataliya.
Bavuye muri Ataliya, baciye bafata ubwato basubira muri Antiyokiya ho muri Siriya, aho bari basengewe ng’Ubuntu bw’Imana buzobane na bo ku bw’ico gikorwa bari barangije.
Bashitse muri Antiyokiya, bakoranya ishengero baryiganira ivyo Imana yabakoresheje vyose, n’ukuntu yugururiye imiryango Abanyamahanga na bo bakizera.
Maze baguma aho, babana n’abigishwa igihe kitari gito.

headings.text: Basubira muri Antiyokiya ho muri Siriya

verses.text: Abantu bamwe bavuye i Yudaya baja muri Antiyokiya, bigisha abizera bati: “Mudakebwe nk’uko imigenzo twigishijwe na Mose ibidutegeka, ntimushobora gukizwa.”

Maze Pawulo na Baranaba binjira mu mpari zikomeye n’abo bantu. Nuko ishengero rica rirungika Pawulo na Baranaba, baherekejwe n’abandi bizera bo muri iryo shengero, ngo baduge i Yerusalemu, kugira ngo bashikirize ico kibazo intumwa n’abakuru b’ishengero.
Nuko ishengero rimaze kubarungika, baca i Foyinike n’i Samariya, biganira abandi bizera ingene Abanyamahanga na bo bizeye Imana, ivyo bitera umunezero mwinshi bene Data bose.
I Yerusalemu bakiriwe n’ishengero hamwe n’intumwa ziri kumwe n’abakuru b’ishengero, na bo babiganira ivyo Imana yabakoresheje vyose.
Ariko bamwe mu bizera bahoze mu mugwi w’Abafarisayo barahaguruka, bavuga bati: “Abanyamahanga bategerezwa gukebwa no gukurikiza Ivyagezwe vya Mose.”
Nuko intumwa n’abakuru b’ishengero barakorana bigira hamwe ico kibazo.

Inyuma y’impari nyinshi, Petero ava hasi, arababwira ati: “Bene Bata, murazi ko mu misi iheze Imana yantoranije muri mwebwe kugira ngo mbwire Abanyamahanga Ubutumwa Bwiza maze na bo bumve, hanyuma bizere.
Imana, yoyo izi imitima y’abantu, yerekanye ko ibemeye mu kubaha Mpwemu Yera, nk’uko yamuduhaye.
Ntiyadutandukanije na bo, kuko yejeje imitima yabo kuko bizeye.
None rero, ni kubera iki mugomba kugerageza Imana mu kuremeka abigishwa imitwaro twebwe ndetse na ba sogokuruza tutashoboye kwikorera?
Ahubwo twizera ko twese dukizwa n’ubuntu bw’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.”
Ishengero ryose rica riracereza, bumviriza Pawulo na Baranaba, na bo bababwira ivy’ibitangaza n’utwumiza Imana yabakoresheje mu Banyamahanga.
Baheje kuvuga, Yakobo aca afata ijambo, aravuga ati: “Bene Data, nimuntege amatwi.
Simoni Petero yadusiguriye ingene kuva mu ntango Imana yitayeho Abanyamahanga kugira ngo ibitoranirizemwo abazokwitirirwa izina ryayo.
Amajambo y’abavugishwa n’Imana aremeranya n’ivyo, kuko handitswe ngo:
‘Inyuma y’ivyo nzogaruka, nsubire nubake inzu ya Dawidi yasambutse. Nzosubira nubake imisaka yaho ndayisanure,
kugira ngo abandi bantu bose baze barondere Uhoraho, barimwo n’Abanyamahanga bitirirwa izina ryanje, ni ko Uhoraho abikora avuze,’
uwabimenyekanishije uhereye kera cane.
Ni co gituma mbona tudakwiye kuremera Abanyamahanga bariko bahindukirira Imana.
Ahubwo dukwiye kubandikira, tukababwira ko bokwirinda kurya ivyaterekerewe ibigirwamana, bakirinda ingeso mbi z’ubusambanyi, kutarya ibikoko vyanizwe hamwe n’amaraso.
Kuko Ivyagezwe vya Mose vyama vyigishwa kuva kera mu masinagogi no mu bisigara, bigasomwa kw’isabato yose.”

Nuko intumwa n’abakuru b’ishengero, bari kumwe n’ishengero ryose, baca batora bamwe mu banyeshengero, babarungika i Antiyokiya baherekeje Pawulo na Baranaba. Nuko batoranya Yuda ari we Barusaba, na Silasi, bari abarongozi mu bandi bizera.
Maze babarungikana ikete ryavuga ritya: Twebwe bene So, intumwa n’abakuru b’ishengero, Turabaramukije mwebwe Abanyamahanga bizera bo muri Antiyokiya, i Siriya n’i Kilikiya.
Twarumvise ko hariho abantu bamwe muri twebwe baje iwanyu tutabatumye, bababwira amajambo abaca ivutu, abahagarika imitima.
Ni co gituma twumvikanye gutoranyamwo abo dutuma, bazananye na bene Data dukunda cane, ari bo Baranaba na Pawulo,
abagabo bahevye ubuzima bwabo ku bw’izina ry’Umwami wacu Yesu Kristo.
Kandi turabarungikiye Yuda na Silasi kugira ngo bemeze n’amajambo y’akanwa kabo ivyo tubandikiye.
Kuko Mpwemu Yera vyamubereye vyiza, kandi natwe bitubera vyiza kutabaremereza ikintu na kimwe kirengeye ivyo tubasaba, ari vyo vy’ibi:
Muze mwirinde kurya ivyaterekerewe ibigirwamana, amaraso canke inyama z’ibikoko binizwe, kandi mwirinde ingeso mbi z’ubusambanyi. Nimwavyirinda muzoba mugize neza. Turabasezeye.
Nuko abo bantu baca barabarungika bamanuka muri Antiyokiya, bakoranya ishengero, babashikiriza iryo kete.
Barisomye baranezerwa cane kuko ryarimwo ubutumwa bubatera intege.
Yuda na Silasi, bari basanzwe ari abavugishwa n’Imana, bongera bababwira amajambo menshi yo kubatera intege no kubakomeza.
Nuko bahamara igihe, hanyuma abizera bo muri Antiyokiya barabasezera n’umuhezagiro w’amahoro, maze na bo basubira ku babatumye. [
Ariko Silasi ahitamwo kugumayo.]
Maze Pawulo na Baranaba bagumye muri Antiyokiya, aho bo n’abandi benshi bigishije bongera bavuga Ijambo ry’Umwami Yesu.
Haheze igihe, Pawulo abarira Baranaba ati: “Ingo dusubire mu bisagara twigishijemwo Ijambo ry’Imana, turabe ingene bene Data bifashe.”
Baranaba yipfuza ko Yohana Mariko ajana na bo,
ariko Pawulo we abona ko bitabereye ko bojana kuko yigeze kubata i Pamfiliya, ntiyabandanyana na bo mu gikorwa.
Nuko haba ukutumvikana gukomeye, bituma batandukana. Baranaba ajana na Mariko, bafata ubwato baja i Kupuro.
Pawulo ahitamwo kujana na Silasi, bamaze gusengerwa n’abizera bakabaragiza ubuntu bw’Umwami Imana.
Aca agendagenda muri Siriya no muri Kilikiya, akomeza amashengero yaho.

headings.text: Inama ihambaye y’intumwa yabereye i Yerusalemu
Inama ihambaye y’intumwa yandikira abanyamahanga bizeye
Ukutumvikana kwabaye hagati ya Pawulo na Baranaba

verses.text: Nuko Pawulo ashika i Derube, hanyuma aja i Lusitira, aho hakaba ariho umwigishwa wa Yesu yitwa Timoteyo yaba. Nyina yari Umuyudakazi yizera, ariko se yari Umugiriki.
Yavugwa neza n’abizera b’i Lusitira n’abo muri Ikoniyo.
Maze Pawulo yipfuza kujana na we ku rugendo yarimwo, araheza abanza kumukeba ku gitsina kubera Abayuda bo muri ako karere bose bari bazi ko se ari Umugiriki.
Mu bisagara bacamwo vyose, bagenda barashikiriza abizera ivyashinzwe n’intumwa n’abakuru b’ishengero b’i Yerusalemu babahimiriza kuvyitondera.
Nuko amashengero arakomezwa mu kwizera, kandi igitigiri c’abizera carongerekana umusi ku musi.
Pawulo na bagenziwe baca mu ntara za Furugiya na Galatiya, kuko Mpwemu Yera yari yababujije kuvuga ijambo ry’Imana muri Aziya.
Bashikiriye urubibe rwa Musiya, bagerageza kwinjira i Bituniya, ariko naho nyene Mpwemu wa Yesu ntiyabemerera.
Nuko baca baca i Musiya bamanuka i Tirowa.
Mw’ijoro, Pawulo arerekwa abona umuntu w’i Makedoniya ahagaze amubwira ati: “Turakwinginze uze i Makedoniya udutabare.”
Pawulo amaze kwerekwa ivyo, duca turitegura ubwo nyene tuja i Makedoniya, kuko twari dutahuye neza ko Imana iduhamagariye kuja kuvugayo Ubutumwa Bwiza.
Nuko tuva i Tirowa mu bwato turaramiriza gushika i Samotirake, ku musi ukurikira naho dushika i Neyapoli.
Tuvuye aho, tuja i Filipi, igisagara gikuru c’i Makedoniya cari carigaruriwe n’Abaroma. Ico gisagara tukimaramwo imisi.
Ku musi w’Isabato, turasohoka tuja inyuma y’igisagara ku ruzi, twibaza ko dushobora kuronka ahantu ho gusengera. Nuko turicara dutangura kuyaga n’abagore bari bahakoraniye.

Umwe mu bariko baratwumviriza yitwa Lidiya, yava i Tuwatira, akaba yari umudandaza w’impuzu z’agaciro kandi yubaha Imana. Nuko Umwami Imana yugurura umutima wiwe, yakira Ubutumwa Pawulo yariko aravuga.
We n’abo mu nzu yiwe bamaze kubatizwa, aca aradutumira iwe avuga ati: “Nimba mubona ko ndi uwizera Umwami Yesu, nimuze mube iwanje.” Nuko aratugobera gushika twemeye.
Umusi umwe, turiko turaja ahantu ho gusengera, duhura n’umuguranokazi yari afise impwemu yo kuragura, yatuma amenya ivya kazoza, agacira amahera menshi ba shebuja mu kuragura.
Maze wa mukobwa akurikira Pawulo n’abo twari kumwe bose, asemerera ati: “Aba bantu ni abakozi b’Imana Musumbavyose, baje kubabwira inzira ibashikana ku gakiza.”
Nuko amara imisi avuga ivyo, gushika aho Pawulo adundumirwa, arahindukira abwira iyo mpwemu ati: “Mw’izina rya Yesu Kristo, ndagutegetse, muvemwo.” Ubwo nyene ya mpwemu ica iramuvamwo.
Maze ba shebuja babonye ko bagiye guhomba amahera yahora abinjiriza, bafata Pawulo na Silasi, babajana imbere y’abatware, mu kibanza gikoraniramwo abantu benshi.
Babazana imbere y’abacamanza b’Abaroma, bavuga bati: “Aba bantu ni Abayuda, kandi bariko baragumura igisagara,
bigisha imigenzo twebwe Abaroma tutemerewe gukurikiza.”
Abari ngaho bose baca bakurira hasi Pawulo na Silasi, ba bacamanza baca bategeka ko babambura impuzu bakabakubita ibimoko.
Bamaze kubakubita cane, baca babaterera mw’ibohero, bategeka umukuru w’ibohero kubarinda cane kugira ngo ntibatoroke.
Kubera iryo tegeko ahawe, aca abashira mu cumba c’ibohero kiri kure, amaguru yabo ayabohera hagati y’ibiti.
Nko mu gicugu hagati, Pawulo na Silasi bariko barasenga bongera baririmba indirimbo zo gutazira Imana, izindi mbohe zarabumva.
Ubwo nyene haba nyamugigima ikomeye cane, inyiganyiza amatanguriro y’ibohero. Imiryango y’ibohero iriyugurura, iminyororo yari iboshe imbohe zose izivako.
Umurinzi w’ibohero yikanguye asanga imiryango yose iruguruye, maze asokorora inkota ngo yiyice kuko yibaza ko imbohe zatorotse.
Ariko Pawulo arasemerera ati: “Reka ntugire ico wigira, twese turi hano.”
Wa murinzi w’ibohero aca atumako urumuri, yiruka mu cumba Pawulo na Silasi barimwo, yikubita imbere y’ibirenge vyabo.
Aca abasohokana hanze, ababaza ati: “Ba nyakwubahwa, nokora iki kugira ngo nkizwe?”
Baramwishura bati: “Izere Umwami Yesu, urakizwa, wewe n’abo mu nzu yawe.”
Baca bamubwira Ijambo ry’Umwami Imana, we n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose.
Iyo saha, muri iryo joro nyene, aca abajana kuboza ibikomere vyabo, maze we n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose baca barabatizwa.
Nuko abajana iwe, arabagaburira, kandi we n’abo mu nzu yiwe bose buzura umunezero kuko bari bizeye Imana.
Bukeye, abacamanza batuma abasoda kuri wa murinzi w’ibohero, ati: “Rekura abo bantu.”
Wa murinzi w’ibohero aca abarira Pawulo ati: “Abacamanza bategetse ko mwe na Silasi murekurwa. None rero murashobora kwigira. Mugende amahoro.”

Ariko Pawulo na Silasi baramwishura bati: “Badutonaguriye imbere y’abantu tutanaburanye kandi urubanza rutadutsinze kandi turi Abaroma, bagirako baduta mw’ibohero, none bagomba kuturekura mu mpisho? Ntibishoboka! Nibaze bo nyene ubwabo, babe ari bo batwirekurira.”
Ba basoda baca baja kubibwira abacamanza. Bumvise ko Pawulo na Silasi ari Abaroma, baca bagira ubwoba.
Baca baja kubahoyahoya, babasohora ibohero, babaherekeza babinginga ngo bave muri ico gisagara.
Pawulo na Silasi bavuye muri iryo bohero baca baja kwa Lidiya, babonana n’abandi bene Data, babatera intege mu kwizera, baca baragenda.

headings.text: Pawulo atora Timoteyo ngo bajane mu bikorwa
Pawulo yerekwa ivyo kuja i Makedoniya
Lidiya yizera, yongera aha indaro intumwa

verses.text: Maze Pawulo na Silasi baca muri Amfipoli na Apoloniya, bashika i Tesalonike, ahari isinagogi y’Abayuda.
Pawulo yinjira mw’isinagogi nk’uko yari asanzwe abigenza. Amara amasabato atatu akurikirana aharira na bo ku Vyanditswe Vyera,
abasigurira yongera abereka ko Kristo yategerezwa kubabazwa no kuzuka mu bapfuye. Akababwira ati: “Uwu Yesu ndiko ndababwira, ni we Kristo.”
Bamwe mu Bayuda banyurwa n’izo nyigisho, baca bifatanya na Pawulo na Silasi, co kimwe n’igitigiri kinini c’Abagiriki bubaha Imana, hamwe n’abagore b’abanyacubahiro batari bake.

Ariko bamwe mu Bayuda bibatera ishari, baca bakoranya abantu b’imburakimazi babakuye mu mabarabara yaho, bagira umugwi munini, hanyuma batangura gutera imigumuko mu gisagara. Nuko binjira mu nzu kwa Yasoni barondera Pawulo na Silasi, kugira ngo babajane imbere y’ikoraniro.

Bababuze baca bafata Yasoni na bamwe muri bene Data, babajana babakwega imbere y’abacamanza, basemerera bati: “Aba bagabo Pawulo na Silasi bateye imigumuko kw’isi hose, none bashitse na hano mu gisagara cacu.
Yasoni ni we yabahaye indaro, kandi bariko barenga amategeko ya Kayisari, bavuga ko hariho uwundi mwami yitwa Yesu.”
Abantu bose n’abatware b’igisagara bavyumvise bagira uruhagarara.
Maze abatware b’ico gisagara baka Yasoni n’abari kumwe na we ingwati y’amafaranga, hanyuma barabarekura.
Bugorovye, bene Data barungika Pawulo na Silasi i Beroya. Bashitseyo, binjira mw’isinagogi y’Abayuda.

Abantu b’i Beroya bari bafise imitima yugurutse kurusha ab’i Tesalonike, kuko bakiriye Ubutumwa Bwiza n’ishaka ryinshi, bakama basesangura Ivyanditswe Vyera umusi ku musi, kugira ngo barabe ko ivyo Pawulo abigisha ari ivy’ukuri.
Nuko benshi mu Bayuda barizera, co kimwe n’abagore n’abagabo b’abanyacubahiro b’Abagiriki.
Maze Abayuda b’i Tesalonike bumvise ko Pawulo ariko yigisha ijambo ry’Imana i Beroya, baca bajayo, bosha abantu gutera imigumuko.
Ubwo nyene bene Data baca barungika Pawulo ajana inzira ija ku kiyaga, ariko Silasi na Timoteyo baguma i Beroya.
Abaherekeje Pawulo bamushikana muri Atenayi, baca basubira i Beroya. Nuko Pawulo abatuma kuri Silasi na Timoteyo ababwira ko boca bamusangayo badatevye.
Pawulo akibarindiririye muri Atenayi, agira intuntu mu mutima kubera ibigirwamana vyinshi yabonye muri ico gisagara.
Ivyo vyatumye yama aja mw’isinagogi yaho, agaharira n’Abayuda n’Abagiriki bubaha Imana, kandi imisi yose yama aja mu bibanza abantu bahuriramwo, agahaririraho n’abo ahasanze.

Maze umugwi w’abanyabwenge bitwa Abepikureyo n’Abasitoyiko, batangura guharira na we. Bamwe barabaza bati: “Mbega ivyo ariko aradedemba ni ibiki?” Abandi bakavuga bati: “Umenga ariko avuga ivy’imana z’inyamahanga.” Ivyo babivuze kuko Pawulo yariko ababwira Ubutumwa Bwiza bwa Yesu n’izuka.
Nuko bamujana imbere y’abagize inama nkuru y’igisagara ari yo bita Areyopago, bamubwira bati: “Twoshobora kumenya izo nyigisho nshasha uzanye?
Ivyo uzanye bimeze nk’ivyaduka mu matwi yacu, tugomba kumenya ivyo ari vyo.”
(Mu bisanzwe abantu bo muri Atenayi n’abanyamahanga bahaba bama bahura ata kindi kibahuje atari ukuvuga n’ukwumviriza inkuri nshasha.)
Nuko Pawulo ahagarara imbere y’ikoraniro rya Areyopago, avuga ati: “Yemwe bantu bo muri Atenayi, ndabona ko mwubaha cane imana zanyu mu buryo bwose.
Kuko igihe nariko ndagendagenda ndaba ivyo mukoresha mu gusenga, nabonye n’igicaniro canditsweko ngo: Ic’imana Itazwi. None rero iyo musenga mutazi ni yo ngira ndababwire.
Imana yaremye isi n’ibiyirimwo ni yo Mwami y’ijuru n’isi kandi ntiba mu nsengero zubatswe n’abantu.
Ntikeneye ko abantu bayifasha nk’aho umenga hariho ico ibuze, kuko ari yo nyene iha abantu ubuzima no guhumeka hamwe n’ibindi vyose.
Mu ruvyaro rw’umuntu umwe yakuyemwo amoko yose iyakwiza kw’isi yose. Ni yo yabashiriyeho igihe bazobaho, ibashingira n’imbibe z’aho bazoba.
Imana yakoze ivyo kugira ngo abantu bayirondere, kandi kugira ngo kumbure nibagerageza kuyirondera baze bayibone, n’aho itari kure y’umuntu n’umwe muri twebwe.
Ni kubera yo tubayeho, tukagendagenda, kandi tukagira ubuzima. Nk’uko bamwe mu bahinga banyu babivuze, ‘Turi uruvyaro rwayo.’
None rero, ko turi uruvyaro rwayo, ntidukwiye kwiyumvira ko Imana imeze nk’igishushanyo gikozwe mu nzahabu, mw’ifeza canke mw’ibuye, biciye mu buhinga n’amaboko vy’abantu.
Ibihe abantu batari bwamenye Imana, iyo Mana nta co ibibagirizako, ariko ubu ihamagarira abantu bose aho bari hose kwihana,
kuko yashinze umusi izocira imanza isi mu bugororotsi, ikoresheje umuntu yagenye. Ivyo Imana yabigaragaje mu maso ya bose mu kumuzura imukuye mu bapfuye.”
Bumvise ivyo kuzuka kw’abapfuye, bamwe baritwengera, ariko abandi bavuga bati: “Tuzosubira kukwumviriza kuri ivyo ikindi gihe.”
Nuko Pawulo aca ava muri iryo koraniro.
Ariko bamwe mu bari aho baca bahinduka abigishwa ba Pawulo, barizera. Muri abo harimwo Diyonisiyo, umwe mu bagize inama ya Areyopago, hamwe n’umugore yitwa Damari, n’abandi.

headings.text: Pawulo na Silasi bavuga Ubutumwa i Tesalonike
Pawulo, Silasi na Timoteyo bashika i Beroya

verses.text: Inyuma y’ivyo Pawulo aca ava muri Atenayi aja i Korinto.

Aho hari Umuyuda yitwa Akwilasi, imvukira y’i Ponto, yari aheruka kuva mu Butaliyano ari kumwe n’umugore wiwe Pirisila, kuko Kayisari Korode yari yategetse ko Abayuda bose birukanwa i Roma. Maze Pawulo aca aja kubarondera.
Bitumwe n’uko bari basangiye umwuga wo kujisha amahema, yaciye abana na bo, barakorana.
Ku misi yose y’Isabato Pawulo yama aja mw’isinagogi guharira n’Abayuda n’Abagiriki, akagerageza kubemeza.
Silasi na Timoteyo bashitse i Korinto bavuye i Makedoniya, Pawulo aca ashira umwanya wiwe wose mu gikorwa co kuvuga Ubutumwa Bwiza, ashingira intahe Abayuda ko Yesu ari we Kristo.
